articleTitle: Range and Velocity Measurement with a Bi-static LiDAR System Based on Optical Phased Array
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Based on a linearly-chirped DFB laser and two multi-layered Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>-On-Si optical phased arrays, bi-static frequency-modulated-continuous-wave (FMCW) ranging and velocimetry are demonstrated at a ranging resolution of 8 mm and a velocity resolution of 1.6 mm/s.

articleTitle: Photonic Physically Unclonable Functions using Ring-Assisted Contra-Directional Couplers
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel silicon-photonic-based Physically Unclonable Function (PUF) using grating-assisted contra-directional couplers integrated with perforated microring resonators. In the worst-case scenario, our device exhibits at least a 0.18 Hamming distance from the destined PUF.

articleTitle: First Penalty-free Real-time Co-frequency Co-time Full-duplex Optical Fiber Transmission with 202.1Tb/s Net Capacity Enabled by Hollow-core 5-element NANF
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: By leveraging extremely-low distributed Rayleigh backscattering in AR-HCF, we report the first real-time 202.1-Tb/s co-frequency co-time full-duplex transmission over a 466-m 5-element NANF based on ultra-wide 12-THz C+L-band EDFAs, exhibiting identical performance to unidirectional transmission.

articleTitle: Cascadability of PPLN-Based Inter-Band Wavelength Conversion for Band-Switchable Multi-Band Optical Cross-Connect
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A band-switchable multi-band optical cross-connect can contribute flexible operation of future multi-band networks. We review an experimental demonstration for cascadability of PPLN-based inter-band wavelength converters with a view to incorporating them into the optical cross-connect.

articleTitle: Comparison of FEC Design Concepts for Higher Error Correction Performance with Utilizing Turbo Product Code
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate several FEC design concepts to enhance a turbo product code with higher overhead ratios. The result illustrates which concept would be effective to obtain higher performance according to the increase of the overhead.

articleTitle: MAC-assisted DSP Architecture for 50G TDM-PON Upstream Triple-Rate Reception
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a MAC-assisted DSP for tri-rate upstream reception of 50G PON, which greatly reduces preamble time and achieves requirements of power budget C+ class for BTB and 20km transmission.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Underwater Optical Ranging with Enhanced Accuracy Under Scattering Conditions Using Multiple Bessel Modes
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a structured beam-based underwater optical ranging system through scattering, and we utilize multiple (>2) Bessel modes for accuracy enhancement. The average error decreases from ~16 mm to ~3 mm when the number of modes increases from 2 to 8.

articleTitle: 1 x 5 MEMS Mode Selective Switch with an Inverse-Designed Silicon Nitride MDM
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present the first experimental demonstration of an inverse-designed 5mode division multiplexer (MDM) in silicon nitride for MEMS-based inter-chip switches. The MDM exhibits high efficiency, wide bandwidth, compactness, robust fabrication, and compatibility with commercial foundry production.

articleTitle: Development of High-Power DFB Lasers with High Reliability
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: High-power DFB lasers in O, S, C and L-band have been developed. RIN below -160 dB/Hz and linewidth less than 25 kHz of the lasers are obtained. Over 5000 hours of accelerated aging test has also been performed.

articleTitle: Field Transmission Performance of Multi-core and Few-Mode Fibers
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This presentation reviews accumulated knowledge on the performance of field-deployed fibers for spatially multiplexed transmission. These are multi-core and few-mode fibers deployed in the Italian city of L'Aquila as part of the INCIPICT testbed for space-division multiplexing.

articleTitle: 110 GHz Plasmonic Lithium Niobate Phase Modulator
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An ultra-compact lithium niobate phase modulator based on the plasmonic slot waveguide is demonstrated with a length of ~16 μm, featuring a bandwidth exceeding 110 GHz and a high-rate operation beyond 90 Gbaud.

articleTitle: 130.6-Tb/s Self-homodyne Coherent Transmission over Weakly-Coupled FMF for Data Center Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate high-capacity MDM self-homodyne coherent transmission over 30-km weakly-coupled 10-mode fiber with specially designed multiple-ring-core profile, achieving a total throughput of 130.6 Tb/s with 9 information-bearing modes carrying 16-λ 120-GBaud PCS 64-QAM signals.

articleTitle: Integrated Coherent Transmit-Receive Optical Sub-Assembly (IC-TROSA) for 140 GBd Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on a high output power (>0 dBm), integrated coherent transmit-receive optical sub-assembly (IC-TROSA) integrating all electro-optical and control functions for single-carrier, coherent transmission up to 800 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Control of Packet over Multi-Granular Optical Networks combining Wavelength, Waveband and Spatial Switching For 6G transport
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper presents an end-to-end transport SDN control system for packet (IP) and multi-granular (WDM/WBDM/SDM) optical networks for 6G transport. The dynamic routing and resource assignment combining wavelength, waveband, and spatial resources is also addressed.

articleTitle: Scaling to 100 modes by exploiting topological confinement
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: By conducting a systematic study of the phenomenon of topological confinement for light transport, we demonstrate a record of 100 unmixed modes over ~22m of fiber with average nearest-neighbor crosstalk of -36 dB.

articleTitle: Transmitter Nonlinearity Mitigation Using Direct Learning Architecture Based Digital Predistortion Coefficients Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose to identify the coefficients of digital predistortion equalizer based on direct learning architecture (DLA) for 100 GBaud 16QAM and 80 GBaud 64QAM transmission. Effective SNR improvement of 0.54dB and 0.66dB were experimentally verified.

articleTitle: Optical Network Design with High Symbol Rate Flexible Coherent Transceivers
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We highlight commercial flexible coherent transceivers, including their features and capabilities for optical networks, and present the versatility of a 140-GBd transceiver in typical optical link configurations from short reach to subsea.

articleTitle: Real-Time 1.2Tb/s Large Capacity DCI Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate real-time WDM transmissions of 39.6 Tb/s (33x1.2Tb/s) over a 172km fibre link. The transmission was accomplished without post-FEC error for >46-hours.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 155 Gbaud PAM4 and PAM6 EML with Narrow High-Mesa EA Modulator for 400 Gbps per Lane Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated 400 Gbps-per-lane EML with narrow high-mesa EA modulator. TDECQ less than 3.3 dB at 310 Gbps (155 Gbaud PAM4) and clear eye diagram at 400 Gbps (155 Gbaud PAM6) were achieved.

articleTitle: State-of-Polarization Monitoring Employing Optical Supervisory Channel Enabling Instantaneous Fluctuation Detection and Localization
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a state of polarization monitoring system employing an optical supervisory channel can detect even short fluctuations of 10 μs with precise localization in the experiment over an FPGA.

articleTitle: Water-to-Air PAM4 Optical Camera Communication Using Long Short Term Memory Neural Network (LSTM-NN)
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a wide field-of-view (FOV) water-to-air transmission using rolling-shutter-based optical-camera-communication (OCC). Long-short-term-memory-neural-network (LSTM-NN) is utilized to mitigate the wavy water-surface induced link outage and to decode 4-level pulse-amplitude-modulation (PAM4) rolling-shutter pattern.

articleTitle: Advanced MLSE with Simple Soft Output Achieving High NGMI for SD-FEC in IM-DD Transmission with Severe Bandwidth Limitation
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a simple LLR-calculation method which modifies the LLR distribution using hard-decision information for IM-DD systems with MLSE and SD-FEC. The proposed method achieves high NGMI in 128-Gbaud PAM4 transmission with 40-GHz bandwidth limitation.

articleTitle: 400G cost-effective EML for B5G/6G Fronthaul Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a cost-effective 400G EML operating within O-band CWDM. This device, designed with an identical active layer, maintains a TDECQ value below 2 dB under 100G PAM4 modulation at 50 ℃.

articleTitle: Quantum-Assisted Digital Signature in an SDN-controlled Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This demo presents a quantum-assisted digital signature protocol implementation exploiting Quantum Key Distribution devices and Software Defined Networking (SDN) control. The demonstration shows an innovative practical employment of quantum technology in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Providing Anomalous Behaviour Profiling by extending SmartNIC Transceiver support in Packet-Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper presents the architectural and data model extensions necessary to provide support for SmartNICs from SDN controller perspective. It later presents a use case for providing anomalous behaviour profiling support using the proposed extensions.

articleTitle: Reducing the linewidth of hybrid integrated III-V/silicon laser by utilizing high-Q multimode-waveguide-based silicon ring resonator
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a hybrid integrated self-injection locking laser (SIL) with an intrinsic linewidth of 1.25 kHz and an external cavity laser (ECL) of 5.3 kHz by leveraging a high-Q multimode-waveguide-based silicon microring resonator (MRR). © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Can the PON Legacy Infrastructure Host Quantum Key Distribution Services?
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The integration of quantum key distribution in the legacy access infrastructure is analyzed considering the optical distribution network characteristics and the coexistence of multiple passive optical network standards providing classical channels, sources of Raman crosstalk.

articleTitle: FPGA Prototyping of CCDM with On-line Configurable Probabilistic Distribution Based on Parallel Arithmetic Coding
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The real-time CCDM and inverse CCDM were realized in an FPGA. The DM and inverse DM achieved a throughput of 16.8GBaud and supported on-line reconfiguration to realize different entropies with fine granularity. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Yb-doped Fibers for kW-Class Fiber Lasers
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a TMI-free 5.2 kW single-mode output from a fiber amplifier using Yb 20/400 fibers with reduced core thermo-optic coefficient. The TMI threshold is increased by 50% compared to that of commercial Yb-doped fibers.

articleTitle: Net-1.8 Tbps/λ Transmission Enabled by C+L-band InP-based Coherent Driver Modulator
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using a newly developed InP-based C+L-band supported coherent driver modulator with an electro-optic 3-dB bandwidth above 90 GHz, an 80km transmission with a net bit rate of 1.8Tbps/λ in the C+L band was successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Latest Progress and Challenges in 300 mm Monolithic Silicon Photonics Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this paper we discuss the latest developments in the GlobalFoundries Fotonix™ program, including enhancements in device performance, packaging, PDK compact models, and inhouse test capabilities.

articleTitle: The Evolution of Open and Disaggregated Optical Networks: From Open Line System to Open Box System
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optical networks have been evolving from proprietary and close systems to open line systems, and further to open box systems. Technologies that enabled the evolution are reviewed and discussed.

articleTitle: A Novel Low Complexity and Precise Transceiver IQ skew Calibration Method for Single Carrier Coherent System
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel precise transceiver IQ skew calibration method utilizing the specially designed training signal for single carrier coherent system. The results show that the estimation error can be within ±0.2ps.

articleTitle: Identification of optical links with heterogenous fiber types in a production network
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We develop a technique to identify fiber type within heterogeneous network links using correlation between lightpath accumulated dispersions. We successfully identified fiber types from real data issued from a continental-size production network running live.

articleTitle: Ultra-large Key Space Multi-dimensional Masking Encryption System for DSM-based D-band Wireless Fronthaul
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We implement a multi-dimensional masking encryption scheme with an ultra-large key space of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">143</sup> in a photonics-aided millimeter radio-over-fiber (ROF) system. The equivalent 1.67GBaud encrypted-4096QAM signal is successfully transmitted and decrypted over a 4.6-km wireless link in the DSM-based D-band wireless fronthaul system.

articleTitle: C+L Band Transmission under Bidirectionally Pumped Distributed Raman Amplification Using Semiconductor Incoherent Pumps
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 100Gbaud DP-16QAM signal transmission over either 150/200 km SSMF/CSF under bidirectionally pumped Raman amplification using semiconductor incoherent sources as forward pumps. We confirm effectiveness of the incoherent sources for high signal quality.

articleTitle: Improved Physics-based Raman Amplifier Model in C+L Networks through Input Parameter Refinement
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an input parameter refinement scheme for the physics-based Raman amplifier model. Experiments over C+L band are conducted. Results show the scheme can lower the physical model’s maximum estimation error by ~2.13 dB.

articleTitle: Space Qualifying Silicon Photonic Modulators and Circuits
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Here we performed the first space experiments of photonic integrated circuits, revealing the critical roles of energetic charged particles. The year-long cosmic radiation does not change carrier mobility but reduces free carrier lifetime, resulting in unchanged electro-optic modulation efficiency and well-expanded optoelectronic bandwidth.

articleTitle: Sub-terahertz interconnection based on Ge-Si photodetector
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The sub-THz inter-chip interconnections are first demonstrated with terahertz photomixers based on standard-process fabricated germanium-silicon photodetectors and bow-tie antennas, featuring a frequency range over 200 GHz.

articleTitle: Ultra-Compact and Ultra-Broadband Mode (De)Multiplexer Utilizing an Asymmetrical Coupler with SWG and Cascaded Tapered Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 25 μm two-mode (de)multiplexer on a silicon-on-insulator platform is demonstrated. Operating in 200 nm bandwidth, it achieves low insertion-loss (< 0.9 dB), minimal crosstalk (< 18.8 dB), and clear eye diagrams at 64 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Generalized Staircase Codes with Arbitrary Bit Degree
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce a natural generalization of staircase codes in which each bit is protected by arbitrarily many component codewords rather than two. This enables powerful energy-efficient FEC based on iterative decoding of Hamming components.

articleTitle: Multimodal traffic monitoring using two co-routed field deployed fibers in metropolitan environments
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present simultaneous monitoring of vehicle and railway traffic and coarse weight estimation by combining and analyzing spectra of vibration traces from two distributed fiber sensors on two co-routed field deployed fibers in metropolitan environments.

articleTitle: Automated Tuning of Ring-Assisted MZI–Based Interleaver for DWDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present an RAMZI auto-tuning structure for DWDM systems, rectifying phase errors and optimizing passband alignment. Experimental results validate improved performance and operational efficiency, facilitating scalable communication infrastructures in high-performance computing systems and data centers.

articleTitle: A 92% Complexity Reduction of Low-Latency Multi-Group Precoding Scheme based on Björck Sequences
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a multi-group precoding scheme based on Björck sequences, achieving a tradeoff between complexity and BER performance. Experiments at ~200 Gb/s demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms OCT while reducing complexity by 92%.

articleTitle: Tailoring Large Scale Manufacturing of MCF to High-Capacity Subsea Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Multicore fiber (MCF) targeted for use in subsea systems is under active development. There are many variables and constraints which must be considered in the design, fabrication, and deployment of this new type of fiber to enable its success. This talk will expand upon the details and performance achieved to date by subsea fiber manufacturers through the lens of manufacturing suitability.

articleTitle: Multi-Section Partially-Corrugated-Grating DFB Lasers for Achieving High Power, Low Noise, and Narrow Linewidth
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel DFB laser structure with multi-section partially-corrugated-gratings (PCG) is demonstrated with enhanced output power, reduced noise, and reduced linewidth, resulting from the equalized photon density in the laser cavity by the partitioned partial gratings.

articleTitle: Subcarrier-Enabled Record Field Trial Demonstration in a Dispersion Uncompensated Ultra-Long Transpacific Cable
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A record real-time transmission is demonstrated over an 18,008 km dispersion uncompensated subsea cable, enabled by subcarrier-based EEPN mitigation and FEC. Numerical analysis supports the field trial’s real-time measurements, quantifying the benefit of subcarrier modulation. ©2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Probabilistically Shaped 64-QAM Transmission via Distortion-aware Phase Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 50-GBaud probabilistically shaped 64-QAM transmission with 5.6-bits/symbol entropy over 80-km SSMF using carrierless intensity-only detection via a distortionaware phase retrieval receiver, resulting net capacity over 200 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Optically Networked Heterogeneous Data-centric Computing System with Silicon Photonics Transceivers
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An architecture is proposed for optically networked heterogeneous computing system supporting CXL standard. The proposed system is applied to AI applications and achieves a performance degradation of less than 2% compared with the server solution.

articleTitle: Inline Fiber Type Identification using In-Service Brillouin Optical Time Domain Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed the use of BOTDA as a monitoring tool to identify fiber types present in deployed hybrid-span fiber cables, to assist in network planning, setting optimal launch powers, and selecting correct modulation formats.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a Compositional Learning Framework for Open and Disaggregated Optical Network Control
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce an automated Compositional Learning Framework, which can dynamically combine ML models to create a composite ML service. It leverages the MLOps principle to streamline drift-aware ML workflows. We showcase its applicability in the dynamic Routing Modulation and Spectrum Allocation scenario with an open disaggregated control platform.

articleTitle: A 7×4 Silicon Photonic Reconfigurable Optical Analog Processor with Algorithmic Calibration
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This work presents a large-scale 7x4 square optical mesh-based programmable analog optical processor, or optical FPGA, fabricated in a standard CMOS-compatible foundry. The processor employs an electronic backend with optimized on-chip monitors and microheaters for algorithmic calibration for the automatic configuration of optical circuits.

articleTitle: Dark soliton microcomb with high conversion efficiency in a 400-nm-thick Si3N4 microring for WDM light sources
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We generate a dark soliton microcomb with a conversion efficiency of 49% and -10 dBm spectral bandwidth of 28 nm in a single 400-nm-thick Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> microring fabricated by a commercial foundry, which supports high-performance WDM light sources.

articleTitle: Optical Frequency Division on SiN-based Platform for Low-noise mmWave Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate integrated optical frequency division using SiN-based reference cavity and microcomb, achieving a 36 dB phase noise reduction. With 100 GHz carrier frequency, phase noise reaches -115 dBc/Hz at 10 kHz offset.

articleTitle: Field Trial of Quantum-Secured IPsec Tunnels with Chip-based QKD
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a field trial of chip-based QKD over 28.5km of deployed G.652 fibre, integrated using RFC 8784 with Juniper routers, with concurrent IPsec tunnels consuming independent keys. This illustrates practical quantum-resilient transport layer communication.

articleTitle: Estimation of Energy Storage Status in Power Supply System Using Power over Fiber for Outdoor Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate that our model for estimating power charging regimes of the power supply system combining power over fiber and an energy storage is very accurate as it accounts for the temperature dependence.

articleTitle: 256 GBd Barium-Titanate-on-SiN Mach-Zehnder Modulator
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 110-GHz BTO Mach-Zehnder modulator integrated on foundry-produced silicon nitride for 340 Gbit/s data links. This approach, featuring nano-scale plasmonics and highly nonlinear BTO, proves to be a viable platform for next-generation Tbit/s links.

articleTitle: High Bandwidth (>35GHz) 1060nm Single-mode Transverse Coupled-cavity VCSEL Array for Single-mode Fiber Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 8ch-1060nm single-mode metal-aperture VCSEL array, exhibiting bandwidth >35GHz, single-mode power of 4mW and error-free 60Gbaud transmission through 2km-single-mode fiber(G.652). Also, uncooled operations up to 85°C with 50Gbps-NRZ and 100Gbps-PAM4 through 2km-SMF are demonstrated.

articleTitle: 4D Optical Link Tomography: First Field Demonstration of Autonomous Transponder Capable of Distance, Time, Frequency, and Polarization Resolved Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the first field demonstration of 4D link tomography using a commercial transponder, which offers distance, time, frequency, and polarization-resolved monitoring. This scheme enables autonomous transponders that identify locations of multiple QoT degradation causes.

articleTitle: Wide-angle vertical coupling gratings enabled by nano-imprinted microlens array
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally show a vertical grating coupler featuring extended coupling angles through nano-imprinted lens array. This nanostructure exhibits a 2-3.4 dB increase in coupling efficiency within the ±15° angular range compared to the bare device.

articleTitle: 1 Million Intrinsic Q-Factor Microring Resonators From PVD Aluminum Nitride on SiO2-on-Si Substrate
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present PVD AlN microring resonators on SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-on-Si substrate with intrinsic Q-factor >1 million at C-band. To the best of our knowledge, this is the highest intrinsic Q-factor reported for PVD AlN on SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-on-Si substrate.

articleTitle: An integrated photonic-electronic quantum coherent receiver for sub-shot-noise-limited optical links
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated quantum-limited coherent receiver with co-packaged silicon photonics and electronics. The fully integrated receiver has 2.57 GHz bandwidth, 14.5 dB shot noise clearance, 587 µW knee power, and 2.7 × 0.8 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> footprint. With this system, we measure squeezed vacuum showing 0.156 ± 0.039 dB sub-shot-noise-level sensitivity.

articleTitle: Broadband Polarization Beam Splitter Rotator Using Only Silicon Nitride
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We designed and fabricated a CMOS-compatible polarization beam splitter and rotator purely in Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, achieving experimentally an insertion loss of ~1.5dB and a polarization extinction ratio greater than 15dB from 1280 to 1320nm.

articleTitle: Inverse-designed CWDM demultiplexer operated in O-band
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce an inverse designed silicon 4-channel CWDM demux with mean worst insertion loss of 2-3.3 dB and mean worst crosstalk of 19-26 dB. Variability and predictability are demonstrated using a commercial CMOS process.

articleTitle: Photonic Layer Encryption in High Speed Optical Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Combining multi-THz optical spectrum spreading, photonic phase encoding, and negative optical signal-to-noise ratio (OSNR) transmission, forms photonic shield that prevents data recording for offline deciphering. This supports post-quantum security by eliminating raw data availability for quantum computers processing.

articleTitle: Reach Extension of Net-200G/λ IM-DD PAM4 Links to Beyond-100km with Low-complexity Using OE-EQ
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report C-band net-202Gb/s/λ IM-DD PAM4 transmission over single-span up-to-100.9km SSMF using only a single-drive intensity modulator, one PD, one ADC, low-complexity DSP and practical FEC, based on a theory-backed optoelectronic equalization (OE-EQ) technique. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Fast, Reliable and Portable Low-loss Antiresonant Hollow-core Fiber Fusion Splicing
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using a fully automated rotational alignment algorithm and a portable 3-electrode arc-discharging fusion splicer, we achieve median splice losses of 0.13 dB between antiresonant hollow-core fibers within 120 seconds with 100% success rate.

articleTitle: Highly Sensitive Co-trench Detection of Optical Fibers by Correlation Analysis with Field Test
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A coherent-OTDR and correlation analysis-based method is proposed to detect co-trench fibers. High sensitivity and accuracy are demonstrated in a field test with two partially co-trenched fibers.

articleTitle: U-Band Transmission Characteristics over Standard Cladding Step-Index 4-Core Fiber Span
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We evaluate the optical and transmission characteristics of a step-index four-core fiber with a standard cladding diameter in the U-band. Transmission over 57 km is demonstrated by applying a bidirectional architecture to suppress the crosstalk.

articleTitle: Performance of Radix Sort using All-to-all Optical Interconnection Network in an Eight-FPGA Cluster
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper presents a high-throughput dataflow processing using all-to-all communication with eight FPGAs. We demonstrated a parallel radix sorting throughput of 37.2 GB/s for 32-bit key range and 16-GiB data size.

articleTitle: Automated Control Plane for Reconfigurable Optical Crosshaul in Next Generation RAN
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The paper proposes a unified automated control plane of an SDN-enabled densely deployed reconfigurable optical crosshaul for future radio access networks, with tested ability to perform sub-second automated reconfiguration on low-cost and low-bandwidth control plane.

articleTitle: A Joint Mode Permutation Architecture for 10-modemultiplexed Long-haul Transmissions
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: For the first time, we propose and experimentally demonstrate a joint mode permutation architecture for 10-mode transmission. Compared with cyclic mode-group permutation, the required equalizer window is further reduced by 30.7%, while the transmission reach is extended to 2000 km. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Frequency Modulated Integrated 780 nm Brillouin Laser with 24 Hz Fundamental and 1.4 kHz Integral Linewidths and 22 kHz Modulation Bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a frequency modulated 780 nm Brillouin laser pumped by a semiconductor laser. We achieve a 1.4 kHz 1/p integral linewidth and 24 Hz fundamental linewidth and a 22 kHz modulation bandwidth.

articleTitle: 21.9 THz-wide Ytterbium Doped Fiber Amplifier for 1 μm Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present an ultra-wideband ytterbium-doped fiber amplifier optimized for 1 μm data transmission, providing a remarkable 21.9 THz bandwidth (1025-1110 nm), with >20 dB average gain and <5.1 dB noise figure.

articleTitle: Will a metro-access optical continuum ever fly? deployment challenges and enabling technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We discuss optical continuum techniques to cut the total cost of ownership of telecom operators optical networks, and review enabling photonic technologies, particularly focusing on recent advances of silicon photonics-based reconfigurable optical add drop multiplexers.

articleTitle: Assessing the Impact of Patterning Effect on Quantum Key Distribution
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We assessed the impact of patterning effect on SKR in QKD while considering statistical fluctuations. Through numerical simulations, compared to WCS, HSPS demonstrated superior resistance to patterning effect and can transmit over longer distances.

articleTitle: Site Dependent Pumping Effect in Super L-band EDFA
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This work shows how pump wavelength would impact the static gain curve distortion of a super L-band EDFA under large input signal power variation. The theoretical model is explored to interpret the experimental observations.

articleTitle: Plasmonically Enhanced Optical Accelerator for Nonlinear Signal Processing Based on Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We reconstruct a 48 Gbit/s nonlinearly distorted optical signal using an artificial neural network (ANN). The digital ANN execution exceeds traditional nonlinear equalizers, while its analog acceleration using plasmonic-organic-hybrid modulators surpasses conventional digital linear equalizers.

articleTitle: Broadband Dual-Polarization 90° Optical Hybrid Array Supporting Spatial Parallelism
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a dual-polarization 90° optical hybrid array with <6° phase errors over 300 nm and showcase a multi-core fiber-compatible coherent receiver array using the hybrid array with a 3-dimensional-waveguide device and a 2-dimensional photo-diode array.

articleTitle: 59-fJ/bit Si Photonic Crystal Slow-Light Modulator with FinFET-Compatible Driving Voltage
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Si Mach-Zehnder modulator with slow-light enhancement of photonic crystal phase shifter consumes a low bit energy of 59 fJ/bit and transmits a 64-Gbaud NRZ signal with a FinFET-compatible driving voltage of 0.87 V.

articleTitle: Expertise-Embedded Machine Learning for Enhanced Failure Management of Optical Modules in OTN
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an expertise-embedded approach for failure management of optical modules in OTN that incorporates expert decision-making logic into data-driven ML models, thereby enhancing inference capabilities. Empirical assessments reveal a marked performance enhancement in models post-embedding, particularly in few-shot failure scenarios.

articleTitle: Ultra-Wideband Mode Selective Couplers for Weakly-Coupled WDM-MDM Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Ultra-wideband mode selective couplers satisfying strict phase-matching conditions across S+C+L bands for mode multiplexing/demultiplexing of a 4-LP-mode FMF are designed and fabricated with side-polishing processing, based on which weakly-coupled FMF transmission is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: 18,090-km 2-core Fiber Transmission Using Circulatory Directional Fan-in/Fan-out Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A record distance of 18,090 km in bidirectional multicore fiber transmission is experimentally demonstrated. Ultra-low loss 2-core fibers and circulatory directional fan-in/fan-out devices synthetically enable to reduce span loss as comparable to single-core fiber systems.

articleTitle: Measurement of optical signal state of polarization in OPGW under lightning strike condition
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We monitored the polarization state of the power grid Optical Ground Wire (OPGW) cable for three months in 100G-OTN system and unprecedented detected the maximum state of polarization (SOP) rotation speed of 43Mrad/s.

articleTitle: End-to-End Joint Digital and Optical Signal Processing Enabled by Interpretable Deep Learning for Coherent Optical Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Joint digital and optical signal processing is enabled by interpretable deep learning to realize end-to-end distributed equalization for optical transmissions. Up to 6.2 dB SNR gain is demonstrated for optical links with cascaded ROADMs.

articleTitle: Joint Network and Computing Resource Optimisation in Distributed Quantum Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an orchestration framework to optimize network and computing resources and minimize degradation from quantum and classical communication in distributed quantum computing interconnect networks.

articleTitle: Real-Time Implementation of Machine-Learning DSP
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: While ML algorithms can learn and adapt to channel characteristics, implementation of ML-based DSP hardware is challenging. We demonstrate a real-time implementation of a model-based ML equalizer that compensates a non-linear and time-varying channel.

articleTitle: Foundry compatible, efficient wafer-scale manufacturing of ultra-low loss, high-density Si3N4 photonic integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate ultra-low propagation loss, lithographic precision, and wafer-scale manufacturing for high-density Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> photonic integrated circuits using an efficient DUV-based subtractive approach. We show a propagation loss as low as 1.4 dB/m at 1.55 µm.

articleTitle: A Partially Etched Silicon Spot-Size-Converter for O Band High NA Fibers
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An O band partially etched silicon edge coupler for 3.3 μm MFD fiber is proposed to enhance coupling efficiency and fabrication tolerance. It's experimentally demonstrated with < 1.25 dB/facet coupling loss and <0.1 dB PDL.

articleTitle: CPRI-equivalent Data Rate of 3.12 Tbps 16384QAM DSM 300GHz Terahertz Wave Signals over Hollow-core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate ultra-large-capacity hybrid fiber and THz-Wave wireless fronthaul over 2-km hollow-core fiber and 2-m wireless distance based on 80 channel WDM and DSM, achieving CPRI-equivalent data rate of 3.12 Tbit/s.

articleTitle: A Multi-Channel Chromatic Dispersion Compensation for 15-km Front-Haul Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report an integrated Bragg grating based multi-wavelength dispersion compensation. We achieve +20 ps/nm and -28 ps/nm at 1270 and 1335nm, with a on-chip loss of 4dB, showing a broadband dispersion compensation capability.

articleTitle: Real-time 100G and 200G Unrepeatered Transmission over 691.8km and 655.9km Respectively
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present records of unrepeatered transmission 100Gb/s and 200Gb/s over 691.8km and 655.9km, respectively. This achievement involved the use of special modulation format, optimal Raman technology, and ultra-low loss & 130 um<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> A<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</inf> fibers.

articleTitle: 40-Gbit/s Mobile FSO with High-speed Beam Stabilizer and 2D-PDA-based Diversity Receiver for Support Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A mobile free-space optical system is experimentally demonstrated with high-speed beam stabilizer and 2D-photodetector array-based diversity receiver. In the 2.1-m line-of-sight link, the 400-mm/s zigzag-moving transmitter successfully transmits the 40-Gbit/s PAM-4 within 7% FEC criterion.

articleTitle: Verification of the Physical Modelling Approach of Spectral Hole Burning in EDFA Based on Erbium Ion Groups
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Our previously presented modelling approach for EDFA spectral hole burning has been extended to be valid at various operating points. It is successfully applied for three different input signals with strong local saturation.

articleTitle: 56G VCSEL Transmission at 980 nm across 500 m Multimode Fiber
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Transmission of 56-Gbps signals across a 500-meter 980 nm optimized multimode fiber with 14.2 GHz·km bandwidth using 980 nm multimode VCSEL is demonstrated. The results show promising performance within IEEE standards for short reach applications.

articleTitle: Ultra-Efficient Interleaved Vertical-Junction Microdisk Modulator with Integrated Heater
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a vertical-junction microdisk modulator with interleaved RF contacts and doped-silicon heater. We measure a resonance ER=36.5 dB, FSR=27.15 nm, and open eye diagrams at 32 Gb/s NRZ with 800 mV peak-to-peak driving signal.

articleTitle: Hertz-linewidth, high-power, frequency-agile photonic integrated E-DBR laser
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate hybrid integration of an RSOA with an extended-distributed Bragg reflector (E-DBR) laser cavity implemented on a Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> chip with monolithically integrated piezoactuators. The laser exhibits intrinsic linewidth of 4 Hz with laser frequency tuning over 1.0 GHz at up to 1 MHz triangular chirp rate.

articleTitle: Throughput Increase in Multi-Fiber Networks using Partial Lane-Change Capabilities
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Effective application of lane change in multi-fiber (MF) networks is hindered by limitations in WSS-size in ROADMs. We show that introducing lane-change only at degree-2 nodes leads to significant throughput increase, for a commensurate additional equipment cost.

articleTitle: Programmable integrated photonic circuit for matrix inversion
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate the optical inversion of a programmable matrix by using a silicon photonic interferometer mesh in a feedback loop, without any optical-to-electronic conversions inside the inversion process.

articleTitle: Optimization of iterative Chase soft decoder based on cross entropy minimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a scheme to optimize the parameters of iterative Chase decoder. Minimizing the cross entropy loss of the final stage Chase decoder output in the form of log-likelihood ratio improves turbo product code performance.

articleTitle: Reinforced Q-Learning Enabled Automatic Blind Working Wavelength Alignment Against Wide Input-Wavelength Shifts and Temperature Variations for Silicon Photonic Vernier Ring Filters
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate long-time (~10 hours) continuous full-C-band automatic working wavelength alignment for silicon photonic cascaded-ring vernier filters against wide input-wavelength and temperature changes using reinforced Q-learning method, without prebuilding look-up table and temperature monitor.

articleTitle: Analysis and Mitigation of Unwanted Biases in ML-based QoT Classification Tasks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We address the problem of mitigating biases in models used for the quality of transmission prediction. The proposed method reduces the relative accuracy difference between samples with different feature values by up to 45%.

articleTitle: A 160 TOPS Multi-dimensional AWGR-based accelerator for Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a novel time-space-wavelength multiplexed AWGR-based photonic tensor multiplier that provides a total computational power of 163.8 TeraOP, offering a ~14x improvement compared to state-of-the-art waveguide-based optical accelerators.

articleTitle: O-Band SOH Mach-Zehnder Modulator Operating at a PAM4 Line Rate of 384 Gbit/s with Sub-Volt Drive Voltage
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an O-band SOH Mach-Zehnder modulator (MZM), enabling 192GBd PAM4 transmission at 384 Gbit/s with sub-volt drive voltages. This is the highest line rate so far demonstrated with an MZM on the silicon platform.

articleTitle: Savitzky-Golay-filter-based Phase Recovery for CV-QKD
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A Savitzky-Golay filter (SGF) is employed to reduce the excess noise introduced by a pilot-tone-based phase recovery in CV-QKD. Results show an improvement of 29.2% in the secret key rate at 10.9 km when the SGF is used.

articleTitle: Extending the OCATA Digital Twin for Optical Connections based on Digital Subcarrier Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Time-domain digital twin models for single carrier and DSCM signals are developed that propagate features to estimate the impact of filter penalties on the BER. Results show remarkable accuracy, which is used for lightpath provisioning.

articleTitle: A Scalable, High-Speed Optical Rotor Switch
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Rotary optical switching enables low-loss microsecond-scale reconfiguration between pre-programmed interconnects with thousands of ports, supporting high-bandwidth and low-latency Rotornet datacenter architectures. We describe a 7 µs 128 × 128 port rotor switch with 4 dB fiber-to-fiber insertion loss and a 1-dB spectral bandwidth of 120 nm.

articleTitle: All-Fiber Raman and Parametric-Assisted Spectral Talbot Array Illuminator for Mode Spacing Multiplication
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An optical frequency comb with multiplied mode spacing of 94.5 GHz and up to 35 dB carrier-to-noise ratio is produced by a hybridly amplified spectral Talbot processor. The output supports frequency comb based coherent communications.

articleTitle: Single-End Crosstalk Measurement Method for Multi-Core Fibers Using Continuous Light Source
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose multi-core fiber (MCF) crosstalk measurement method which requires only one fan-in/fan-out at a single end of MCF, and is applicable to short MCFs whose crosstalk is difficult to be measured using OTDR method.

articleTitle: CW-WDM MSA compatible 100-mW (up to 50°C), 400-GHz spacing highly-reliable CW-DFB 8-channel laser array
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a CW-WDM MSA compatible 8-channel 400-GHz spacing 100-mW CW-DFB laser array, with uniform channel spacings (±100 GHz) from 20 to 75°C, small channel-to-channel power deviations (0.56 dB) and over 2000-hour-operation reliability at 80°C.

articleTitle: Photon-number-resolving and ultra-fast multipixel SNSPD arrays for quantum photonic platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on a high-efficiency multipixel SNSPD array detecting at > 1.5 GHz and that has excellent photon-number resolving (PNR) capability at 1550 nm. This device enables ultrafast QKD with > 60 Mbps secret key rate, and also PNR detection with high n-photon efficiencies for photonic quantum processors with various types of photon sources.

articleTitle: 0.08 fF, 0.72 nA dark current, 91% Quantum Efficiency, 38 Gb/s Nano-photodetector on a 45 nm CMOS Silicon-Photonic Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated a Germanium-on-Silicon photodetector utilizing an asymmetric-Fabry-Perot resonator with 0.08 fF capacitance. The measurements at 1315.5 nm show 0.72 nA (3.40 nA) dark current, 0.93 A/W (0.96 A/W) responsivity, 36 Gb/s (38 Gb/s) operation at -1V (-2V) bias.

articleTitle: Fiber Bundle Fan-in/Fan-out (FIFO) for Coupled MCF with High-Δ 4-Core Fiber Pitch Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Low-loss fiber bundle FIFO with stretched high-Δ 4-core fiber pitch converter is developed. Core pitch and insertion loss of the FIFO are reduced to 18.4 μm and 0.84 dB including splice loss to CC-MCF.

articleTitle: QoT Estimation for Large-scale Mixed-rate Disaggregated Metro DCI Networks by Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed an artificial neural network (ANN)-based QoT estimator for large-scale mixed-rate disaggregated metro DCI networks with an estimation error standard deviation of 0.3 dB, outperforming analytical-based methods with vendor-specific transponder SNR characterization.

articleTitle: Using P2MP Transceivers as Regenerators in Disaggregated and Multi-Rate Regional Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate the role of point-to-multipoint (P2MP) transceivers as regenerators in multi-rate regional optical networks. By smart placement of P2MP devices, we are able to reduce transceiver count by 29% and free up spectral resources.

articleTitle: Integrated Photonic Resonant Modulator-Based Equalization and Optimization for DWDM
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We perform multi-wavelength signal equalization and optimization in a DWDM SiPh link by adjusting the operating regime of integrated resonant modulators. An effective increase in the optical link’s dynamic range of >3 dB is measured.

articleTitle: W-Band Photonics-aided ISAC Wireless System Sharing OFDM Signal as Communication and Sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the dual functionality of OFDM signals for both communication and sensing. Photonics-aided ISAC system in W-band achieves range-Doppler imaging with 0.0102m resolution and data rate of 48.04 Gbit/s over wireless link.

articleTitle: Low-loss and broadband adiabatic polarization splitter rotator on a CMOS-integrated silicon photonics platform
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an adiabatic polarization-splitter-rotator on a monolithic SiPh platform. Our measurements indicate an insertion-loss of ~-0.42dB for TM input and polarization-dependent-loss of <0.1dB across the O-band, accompanied by a polarization extinction exceeding 45dB.

articleTitle: Solutions to Increase Energy Efficiency of Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Power consumption of devices and network functionalities in optical infrastructures is reviewed. Then, possible short-, medium-, and long-term solutions to reduce and make energy consumption scalable are discussed.

articleTitle: Large-Core Optics for Simplified Short-Range FSO Links
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We evaluate large-core FSO links where excellent coupling pairs with bandwidth fading due to multi-mode propagation. The 10-Gb/s/λ limit for 105-µm double-clad fibers is mitigated by spectral launch tuning, restoring 84% of single-clad 25-Gb/s/λ capacity.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Optical Encryption Using Quantum Keys: Two Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optical encryption using Quantum keys retrieved from real QKD and QRNG systems will be demonstrated. Retrieved keys are expanded to the required bitrate and then used to encrypt the input bit stream at line speed.

articleTitle: Broadband InGaAs mHEMT THz Transmitters and Receivers
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe THz amplifier and front-end modules that have been developed based on an InGaAs metamorphic HEMT (mHEMT) technology for THz-wireless communication applications around 300 GHz, covering the frequency range between 270 and 330 GHz and enabling record output-power levels above 10 dBm. Furthermore, we report on the development of state-of-the-art distributed mHEMT circuits with absolute bandwidths in excess of 300 GHz as building block of next-generation ultra-broadband THz front ends.

articleTitle: High efficiency high-power uncooled CWDM4 wavelength CW-DFB lasers
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate high 75°C power conversion efficiencies of 19% to 26% at 100 mW (1mm cavity) and 16% to 22% at 200 mW (2mm cavity) for CW-DFB lasers with single-mode operation across CWDM4 wavelengths.

articleTitle: Real-Time In-Line Coherent Distributed Sensing over a Legacy Submarine Cable
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an inband real-time C-OFDR distributed acoustic sensing system over ≈2000km (NZ-DSF) submarine cable without Bragg-reflector loopbacks. We achieve 2 ms update for phase and ≈200m spatial resolution with zero induced penalty on live transceivers.

articleTitle: First Line-rate End-to-End Post-Quantum Encrypted Optical Fiber Link Using Data Processing Units (DPUs)
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first 92.3-Gbits/s line-rate, end-to-end post-quantum cryptography optical fiber link based on HW accelerators and processing offloading.

articleTitle: End-to-end QoT Predictions enhanced by GNPy-based Digital Twin with Network Telemetry
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Digital twin for dynamic optical networks is implemented using GNPy, network telemetry and databases. It enhances ML-based End-to-End QoT predictions in field trials by supporting model pre-training and minimizing data requirements through the AI engine.

articleTitle: Distortion Characterization and Performance Estimation of Time-interleaved DAC and ADC Based on the Measurement of Nonlinear Noise Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Unlike many nonlinear devices, the time-interleaved DAC and ADC can be characterized by simple notch method accurately due to their unique nonlinear mechanism. By constructing equivalent model with measured noise spectrum, nonlinear system Q is estimated with 0.2-dB accuracy.

articleTitle: QoT-Aware Adaptive Multi-Band Networking over Hybrid Fibers Enabled by Wavelength-Selective Band Switching
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate highly adaptive multi-band networking for diverse physical-layer conditions. Using our wavelength-selective band-switchable OXC prototype, we demonstrate adaptive C+L-band spectrum utilization over hybrid SMF/DSF links as link-by-link band selection can suppress nonlinear interference accumulation.

articleTitle: Learning to Extract Distributed Polarization Sensing Data from Noisy Jones Matrices
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We consider the problem of recovering spatially resolved polarization information from receiver Jones matrices. We introduce a physics-based learning approach, improving noise resilience compared to previous inverse scattering methods, while highlighting challenges related to model overparameterization.

articleTitle: Enabling Endogenous DAS in P2MP Digital Subcarrier Coherent Transmission System with Enhanced Frequency Response
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an endogenous DAS in P2MP digital subcarrier coherent transmission systems. By redesigning and reusing FrFT-based synchronization pilots, vibrations up to 12 kHz are successfully detected over 10-km-long fiber, along with 100-Gb/s 16QAM transmission.

articleTitle: Breaking the interconnection limit by integrating CMOS electronics on PICs
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the integration of electronic functionalities into state-of-the-art photonic platforms with zero changes to the technology. This enables time-multiplexed closed-loop control of programmable silicon photonic meshes with a reduced number of electrical interconnections.

articleTitle: Demonstration of W-band 2×2 MIMO Millimeter Delivery Employing CMA and MRC Technology with over 7dB Gain
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 32 GBaud QPSK signal transmission over a 2 m wireless range at 93.5 GHz using CMA and MRC techniques with over 7 dB gain in a photon-assisted millimeter wave 2×2 MIMO communication system.

articleTitle: Feedback tolerant quantum dot lasers integrated with 300mm silicon photonics
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first quantum dot lasers integrated with 300mm silicon photonics. The measured devices show a linewidth enhancement factor near zero and are resilient to optical feedback up to -16dB of back reflection.

articleTitle: Dual band wireless transmission over 75-150GHz millimeter wave carriers using frequency-locked laser pairs
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We generate and transmit 75-GHz-bandwidth OFDM signals over the air using three mutually frequency-locked lasers, achieving minimal frequency gap between the wireless W and D bands using optical-assisted approaches, resulting in 173.5 Gb/s detected capacity.

articleTitle: Flexible capacity wireless communication in THz-band with Michelson interferometer-based THz-wave filter
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report wireless communication in the 300 GHz-band, which uses variable channel number and symbol rate signals. We demultiplexed densely allocated 8 to 32 Gbit/s signals directly in the THz-domain using a Michelson interferometer-based filter.

articleTitle: Mode-Selective Reconfigurable Optical Add-Drop Multiplexers Experimentally Validated with 40 Gbps NRZ/PAM4
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a mode-selective ROADM for two transverse-electric modes using a mode-selective phase shifter in the switch. We show 40 Gbps NRZ transmission and 20 GBaud PAM4 transmission for two simultaneously transmitted optical modes.

articleTitle: Quantum-safe 10 Gbps Site-to-Site IPsec VPN Tunnel over 46 km Deployed Fibre
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We successfully demonstrated a 10 Gbps QKD-secured IPsec VPN tunnel between two JPMorgan Chase datacenters in a metro network over 46 km of deployed telecom fiber with over 168 hours of continuous operation.

articleTitle: Live Demonstration of Autonomous Link-Capacity Adjustment in Optical Metro-Aggregation Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a real-time ML-assisted network automation pipeline for dynamic, autonomous link-capacity allocation based on traffic-flow forecasting for optical metro aggregation networks. Its performance is compared to that of a classic, static bandwidth provisioning scheme.

articleTitle: Monolithic Integration of Silicon Quantum Photonics and Electronics in a 45nm SOI CMOS Foundry Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Silicon photonics can enable useful quantum information processing, but scaling the interface to calibration and control circuits remains challenging. We monolithically integrate quantum photonics with electronics in a standard CMOS foundry to address this issue.

articleTitle: Optical Multipath Interference Reduction Using Adaptive DC-Removal in High-Speed IM/DD Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present an experimental study of multipath-interference reduction techniques for 56GBd and 92GBd PAM-4. By extending the equalizer with an adaptive removal of intensity fluctuations, MPI tolerance is increased by 2 and 10 dB, respectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of SBS-Induced Performance Penalties and Their Mitigation in 50G TDM-PON Downstream
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study SBS for 50G TDM-PON downstream showing that considerable performance penalties can occur depending on the specific operating conditions of the transmitter. Frequency dithering can mitigate SBS without impact on other performance metrics.

articleTitle: Optimizing Key Consumption in Switched QKD Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We consider a switched QKD network and develop a novel scheduling algorithm that periodically configures the QKD links to optimize the generation and buffering of keys to maximize the key consumption rate across the network.

articleTitle: Secure Architecture for Quantum Key Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a new architecture, designed to improve security of QKD networks. The Trusted Nodes are divided into Core Nodes, which XOR the keys from various QKD devices, and Edge Nodes, connected to key users. © 2024 ID Quantique

articleTitle: Employing Fiber Loss Degradation Statistics in SLA based Margin Calculation Method for Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a statistical analysis of fiber loss degradation with data from a live production network. A proper model is proposed to investigate system margins under typical scenarios with different operation conditions.

articleTitle: C Band Single Wavelength 1.68Tb/s Optical Interconnect over 12.18-km 7-core Multicore Fiber
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a single-wavelength 112GBaud PAM4 signal transmission over 12.18-km 7-core MCF at C band using FFE, under 7% HD-FEC threshold. Furthermore, a maximum data rate of 1.68-Tb/s is achieved with PAM8 and simplified VNLE.

articleTitle: Lithographic Aperture VCSELs Enabling Beyond 100G Datacom Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper reports the first demonstration of lithographic aperture VCSELs with bandwidth above 29 GHz. Large-signal measurements and preliminary lifetime data are reported, putting forward lithographic aperture as an enabling technology for applications beyond 100G.

articleTitle: High-Performance Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Mach-Zehnder Modulator on 8-Inch Silicon Substrate
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We first report the thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) electro-optic Mach-Zehnder modulator (MZM) on an 8-inch silicon substrate fabricated in the back-end-of-line (BEOL) of CMOS foundry. It operates at 1550 nm with electro-optical response of only 1.5 dB roll-off at 67 GHz.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Silicon Photonic Transmitter for Space Based Communications Nodes
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present the first reconfigurable silicon-photonic link capable of both coherent and intensity modulation/direct detection (IM-DD). We experimentally demonstrate error free OOK, BPSK, and QPSK modulated signals all on a single transmitter.

articleTitle: Digital Coherent Receiver Based Optical Performance Monitoring Technology and its Application to Photonics Tomography
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Digital-coherent-receiver-based fiber-longitudinal power profile estimation (PPE) over multiple spans is presented. We then review three specific examples of applications of photonics tomography based on PPE and discuss the comparison between hardware and software implementation.

articleTitle: Circuit Implementation of Pilot-Based Dynamic MIMO Equalization for Coupled-Core Fibers
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We explore ASIC implementation for pilot-based MIMO equalizers for coupled-core transmission, considering chip area scaling trends and performance impact of time-dependent drift. For a system with 28-GBd subcarriers, an equalizer for 8 × 8 is 5.3 times larger than for 2 × 2.

articleTitle: Opportunities and Challenges of Optical Communications in Autonomous Driving Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Autonomous driving vehicles require high bandwidth due to the increased sensors and improved architectures. Optical communications provide several advantages over copper cables in intra-vehicle networks, but face many challenges, especially because of the harsh environment.

articleTitle: InP-based Optical Devices Integrated on Silicon Photonic Circuits
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review our III-V/Si hybrid integration platform using chip-on-wafer direct bonding technique and the performance of hybrid lasers with InP-based gain regions on Si photonic circuits.

articleTitle: Self-locking of free-running DFB lasers to a single microring resonator for dense WDM
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We self-injection lock two DFB lasers to a microring resonator, to enhance frequency-spacing stability, and use these to carry channels with <1 GHz guard-band.

articleTitle: Optimization of Pilot-Aided Joint Phase Recovery for Frequency Comb-Based Wideband Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We numerically investigate joint pilot-aided phase recovery for frequency comb-based long-haul wideband transmission. We report net information rate gains by optimizing the pilot overhead and phase estimation algorithm, outperforming per-channel processing at lower complexity.

articleTitle: Stand-alone 3C-SiC-based Single-photon Source modules for Quantum Key Distribution
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose the stand-alone 3C-SiC-based single photon source modules for Quantum Key Distribution. They emit single-mode-fiber-coupled single photons at high count rates and operate at room temperature near the telecom O-band.

articleTitle: Multi-Span Optical Power Spectrum Prediction using ML-based EDFA Models and Cascaded Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We implement a cascaded learning framework using component-level EDFA models for optical power spectrum prediction in multi-span networks, achieving a mean absolute error of 0.17 dB across 6 spans and 12 EDFAs with only one-shot measurement.

articleTitle: Correlation-Based OTDR for High-Resolution Monitoring in Passive Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Utilizing correlation detection and comical optical transceivers, we detected <-58 dBm reflection signals with <10 cm spatial resolution in typical PON scenarios. Optical power monitoring and fault diagnosis are accomplished through analyzing the correlation results.

articleTitle: Orchestration of Entanglement Distribution over a Q-LAN using the IEQNET Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We will demonstrate orchestration of entanglement distribution over a quantum local area network (Q-LAN) using a quantum network controller. Our controller enables multiple users to share a Q-LAN composed of commercial equipment for quantum communications.

articleTitle: Near-field Multi-source Localization and Signal Enhancement for Fiber-optic DAS
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The near-field multi-source localization and enhancement based on array signal processing (ASP) method are proposed for the distributed acoustic sensing (DAS), and it has been demonstrated with high positioning accuracy and great signal enhancement.

articleTitle: Linear-Drive Amplifier-Less 112 Gbit/s PAM4 Operation of a Silicon-Organic Hybrid (SOH) Mach-Zehnder Modulator at 265 mVpp
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an optically packaged silicon-organic hybrid (SOH) Mach-Zehnder modulator operating at PAM4 data rates of up to 112 Gbit/s. The device is directly driven by a CMOS SerDes chip without additional optical or RF amplifiers.

articleTitle: Hollow-Core-Fiber Placement in Latency-Constrained Metro Networks with edgeDCs
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate the optimal placement of Hollow-Core Fibers (HCF) in latency-constrained metro networks with edgeDCs, performing physical-layer validation. Upgrading 24% of links to HCF reduces edgeDCs number by 29% compared to a network without HCFs.

articleTitle: S+C+L WDM Coherent Transmission with >1-Tb/s/λ Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Ultra-wideband wavelength-division-multiplexed (WDM) transmission is an essential technology to achieve >100-Tb/s single-mode-fiber (SMF) capacity. This paper overviews the status of high-capacity SMF transmission and provides our research results using high-symbol-rate coherent channels under a triple-band WDM configuration.

articleTitle: Single-Shot Ultra-Broadband Spectrometer with Cascaded Nanobeam Mirrors
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a novel reconstructive spectrometer with cascaded nanobeam mirrors. A compact SiN spectrometer is demonstrated achieving <0.5 nm resolution across 160 nm bandwidth with only 15 sampling channels, yielding a record-high spectral pixel-to-channel ratio.

articleTitle: Frequency Response Modeling and Saturation Power Improvement of Lateral-PIN Germanium Photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A frequency response model is developed for Germanium photodetector under large input optical powers. The model agrees well with the measurement results. Furthermore, a simple approach using parallel photodetection is demonstrated with ≥3-dBm saturation power.

articleTitle: Is unceasing increase of channel symbol rate the panacea for WDM transparent meshed networks?
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In the context of transparent meshed WDM networks, we illustrate and explain why very large channel symbol rate (288 GBd) can adversely reduce the achievable total network capacity, whilst still improving global expenditures per Gb/s.

articleTitle: Distributed vibration sensing and simultaneous self-homodyne transmission of single-carrier net 5.36 Tb/s signal using 7-core fiber
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate self-homodyne coherent transmission of a space-division multiplexed dual-pol 120-Gbaud 16 QAM signal achieving a single-carrier net data rate of 5.36 Tb/s, and simultaneously distributed vibration sensing using a 41.4 km weakly-coupled 7-core fiber.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable All-Optical Integrated Nonlinear Activator with Switchable Response Functions for Photonic Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a reconfigurable all-optical integrated nonlinear activator with switchable response functions, including Gaussian, Radial Basis, Softplus, leaky ReLU, Swish and clamped ReLU functions, especially all triggered by low-power inputs.

articleTitle: O-band QKD link over a multiple ONT loaded carrier-grade GPON for FTTH applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We have successfully integrated an O-band commercial Quantum-Key-Distribution (QKD) system over a lit GPON testbed that replicates a carrier-grade Fiber-to-the-Home (FTTH) optical access network with multiple ONTs to emulate real-life FTTH operational deployments.

articleTitle: Single Carrier net 400 Gbit/s IM/DD over 400 m Fiber enabled by Plasmonic Mach-Zehnder Modulator
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 437.1Gbit/s IM/DD link by employing a 178GBd PAM8 signal encoded by a plasmonic MZM. Symbol rates of up to 256GBd and transmission over 400m while maintaining net-rates of >400Gbit/s are successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Point-to-Multipoint Diversity Gain in a 1.6-Tb/s-Class Subcarrier-Multiplexed Coherent System
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We reveal a diversity gain in point-to-multipoint systems when the end points experience various channel conditions. We demonstrate rate improvement over the conventional time-division multiple access in an 18×10-GBaud subcarrier-multiplexed coherent system.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of An Efficient Correlation Attack Method in 300km QAM/QNSC Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an efficient correlation attack based on low-order demodulation to recover the seed keys in QNSC. Experiment results prove its high success possibility and low computational complexity in 300km QAM/QNSC transmission.

articleTitle: Reliability Enhancement in FSO Communications Using FMF Assisted by Subcarrier Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We exploit the frequency diversity offered by digital subcarrier-multiplexing to overcome the coherent combining challenge associated with the use of FMF in FSO systems. Experimental validation at 200Gbps in an atmospheric chamber reveals reliability gains of >20% compared with an equivalent single-mode coupling system.

articleTitle: Universal Optical Logic Gates on a Programmable Silicon Photonic Platform
