publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate the implementation of NOT, OR/NOR, and AND/NAND logic gates compatible with integrated photonics. Using a programmable photonic platform consisting of a Mach-Zehnder interferometer mesh, universal logic gates are experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Hybrid TFDM Coherent PON Featuring Adaptable Capacity and Out-of-band Communication Channels
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a novel TFDM coherent PON architecture supporting adaptable modulation across subcarriers. Experimental validation highlights its flexibility in various link distance/splitting configurations, featuring out-of-band communication subcarriers. Downstream broadcasting and upstream burst transmission were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Waveguide Raman Sensing for Chemical Detection in Industrial Processes
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Waveguide-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (WERS) is a promising method for detecting chemical and biological compounds with high sensitivity and selectivity on a chip-scale platform, but has so far been limited to demonstrations in research laboratories. We present the implementation of a fibre-coupled WERS sensing system in an industrial bioproduction process.

articleTitle: Real-time transmission of 34.9 Tb/s with 1-Tb/s channels over 4800 GHz-wide C-band along 1000 km of G654E fiber
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We transmit 34.9 Tb/s over the 4800 GHz-wide C-band through ten 100km-long G654E fiber spans. This is a record spectral efficiency with real-time 1-Tb/s 128-GBaud transponder and pure Erbium-doped-fiber-based amplification along 1000km core/regional distance.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of an 8-Gbit/s QPSK Coherent Underwater Wireless Optical Communication Link Under Scattering Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an 8-Gbit/s QPSK coherent underwater wireless optical communication link under scattering conditions at 532 nm. We achieve BER below 20% FEC limit under attenuation length up to 6.5, and the corresponding receiver sensitivity is -29.8 dBm.

articleTitle: Ultra-Fast Ge-on-Si Photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A Ge-fin photodetector in which un-doped germanium is laterally sandwiched between complementary in situ-doped silicon is demonstrated, allowing for unprecedented 3-dB bandwidths up to 265 GHz. Here, we review our work on ultra-fast Ge photodiodes.

articleTitle: Characterizing Fiber Nonlinearity with Deployed Equipment in Optical Line Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce the first measurement procedure to characterize fiber nonlinear parameters of all fibers in an optical network using widely deployed network equipment which does not rely on modem measurements or external instrumentation.

articleTitle: Carrier Frequency Offset Estimation Using Godard Timing Recovery in Coherent Optical Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Based on conventional timing recovery (TR) algorithm, we propose a novel method for carrier frequency offset (CFO) estimation by exploiting the available spectrum information from TR. We experimentally validate our proposal in 4-subcarrier 100-GBaud coherent systems.

articleTitle: An Integrated Gallium Phosphide Travelling-Wave Optical Parametric Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate optical continuous-travelling-wave parametric amplification in a 5.55-cm-long integrated gallium phosphide waveguide, achieving up to 35 dB of gain and significantly surpassing the bandwidth of erbium-doped fiber amplifiers.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated magneto-optical isolators, circulators and phase shifters on SiN photonics
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report monolithically integrated magneto-optical isolators, circulators on SiN with 30 dB isolation ratio, -28 dB cross-talk, 54 nm 20 dB isolation bandwidth, and 2.7 dB insertion loss. Compact magneto-optical phase shifter arrays with V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf>L=0.3 V•cm were also developed, allowing the development of MHz speed optical phased arrays on SiN.

articleTitle: First Impact Movement Characterization of Shallow Buried Live Subsea-Cable
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Revealing availability threats and security attacks using State of Polarisation monitoring shows impact characteristics from a cable trencher passing over, moving a subsea cable carrying live traffic while dBQ value dips 0.6 dB.

articleTitle: Integrated Coherent Optical Fiber Communication System with Discrete-Time Analog Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate an integrated coherent optical fiber communication system based on discrete-time analog transmission (DTAT-IOFC). The experimental results indicate that DTAT-IOFC exhibits better performance and achieves 6 dB optical signal-to-noise ratio gain.

articleTitle: 300-Gbit/s/λ PAM8 Modulation with a Silicon Microring Modulator using Long Short Term Memory Regression and Deep Neural Network Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 300-Gbit/s PAM8 modulation using a 55-GHz bandwidth silicon-microring-modulator (SiMRM) with a driving voltage of 1.8-Vpp. To achieve high-order PAM8 modulation, long-short-term-memory (LSTM) and deep-neural-network (DNN) are used for regression and classification respectively.

articleTitle: Hyperaccelerated Power Optimization in Multi-Band Elastic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show that solving interrelated inverse differential equations can address pre-tilt power optimization, resulting in a few-second-computed optimal power for each span and boosting average channel generalized signal-to-the-noise ratio (GSNR) by up to 0.5 dB.

articleTitle: Multi-Wavelength DFB Laser with High Mode Stability and Uniform Spacing via REC Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The multi-wavelength DFB lasers with four and six wavelengths simultaneously emitted are experimentally demonstrated for the emerging optical I/O technology. The proposed structure shows high mode stability and high uniform wavelength spacing of 100 GHz.

articleTitle: Can photonics help in reducing the power consumption in Radio Access Networks?
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: we discuss the challenges of future radio access networks in meeting the growth of traffic without a parallel explosion of energy consumption. The opportunities offered by integrated photonics technologies are analyzed.

articleTitle: Adaptive Reconciliation for Experimental Continuous-Variable Quantum Key Distribution Over a Turbulent Free-Space Optical Channel
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate adaptive reconciliation for continuous-variable quantum key distribution over a turbulent free-space optical channel. Additionally, we propose a method for optimising the reconciliation efficiency, increasing secret key rates by up to 8.1%.

articleTitle: Topological Rotation Symmetry-Based Wavelength Allocation for Entanglement Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a wavelength allocation scheme based on topological rotation symmetry for entanglement distribution networks, reducing the number of wavelength channels required for N users from the order of O(N) to $O(\sqrt N )$ 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Process-tolerant III-V/Si Membrane Distributed Reflector Lasers and 50-Gb/s Direct Modulation at 80°C
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate distributed reflector lasers based on a III-V/Si membrane platform that includes quantum well intermixed distributed Bragg reflectors offering tolerance to fabrication errors. The laser was used to transmit 50-Gb/s PAM4 signals at 80°C.

articleTitle: Multi-Transverse Mode Multiply-and-Accumulate Operation toward Advancement of Photonic Accelerators
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel mode-division-multiplexing subsystem achieving four output power levels using two single-bit rings on two TE modes for photonic accelerators. The photodetector combines the energy of two TE modes without requiring coherent summation.

articleTitle: A Tale for Many: Integrated Control Mechanism of Optical Circuit Switching for Data Center and Distributed Deep Learning System
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an integrated control mechanism of optical circuit switching for both general data center traffics and deep distributed learning applications. Semi-physical evaluations show a relative throughput of 1.27 and a 6.18× speedup in a 256-block network constructed by MEMS-based optical switches.

articleTitle: Employment of polarization diversity architecture to mitigate an impact of pump phase modulation in FOPA
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate via simulations and experiments that a FOPA polarization-diverse architecture allows to mitigate an impact of pump phase modulation on amplified signals and thus reduce or almost eliminate the signal required-OSNR penalty.

articleTitle: 102-Tbit/s C-Band WDM-MDM-PDM Transmission over 1000-km FMF Enabled by Advanced Block-Wise MIMO-FD-DFE
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A high-performance block-wise MIMO-FD-DFE is proposed and experimentally verified in an 80-channel MDM system at the C-band for ISI compensation, which extends the transmission distance by over 33.33% at 20% SD-FEC threshold.

articleTitle: A Grating Coupler With High Coupling Efficiency and Large Bandwidth for Silicon-on-Insulator Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Conventional grating couplers show a tradeoff between low-loss and broadband operation. By using the interference of counter-propagating waves, we demonstrate a grating coupler design with a simulated coupling efficiency-1dB-bandwidth product of 77 nm.

articleTitle: Optical Network Anomaly Detection and Localization Based on Forward Transmission Sensing and Route Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce a novel scheme to detect and localize optical network anomaly using forward transmission sensing, and develop a heuristic algorithm to optimize the route selection. The performance is verified via simulations and network experiments.

articleTitle: Low-Complexity 4D×D MIMO Equalizer Enabling 2.6-Tb/s/λ SDM Signal Reception over Dynamic Four-Coupled-Core Cabled Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a transceiver-impairment-tolerant 4D×D multiple-input/multiple-output equalizer with significantly reduced computational overhead and improved tracking performance for spatial-division-multiplexed receivers and demonstrated it in a 100-Gbaud transmission over a cabled four-coupled-core transmission line with MHz-class fluctuation.

articleTitle: EML-based Coherent Receiver for Low CSPR Single-Sideband Transmission Enabled by Injection Locking
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel single-sideband self-coherent detection scheme employing an EML-based receiver and demonstrate a 6.5-dB sensitivity improvement compared with Kramers-Kronig receiver for the SSB 16-QAM signal transmission over 40-km SSMF.

articleTitle: IMDD Data Transmission with Microresonator Soliton Crystals
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Intensity modulated direct detection data transmission using microresonator multi-soliton and 2-soliton crystal states are demonstrated. We achieve error free transmission of 10Gb/s NRZ data and BERs in the region of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> with 28.05GBd/s PAM4 data.

articleTitle: 50G Burst-Mode Receiver Using Monolithic SOA-UTC and Burst-Mode TIA
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 50G-PON upstream SOA-UTC based receiver integrated with a BM-TIA, without optical filtering. The OMA sensitivity is -24.3 dBm, the dynamic range exceeds 20 dB and the loud-soft penalty is 1 dB.

articleTitle: Clock Recovery of a 180 Gbaud Faster-than-Nyquist Signal Enabled by a Novel Adaptive Equalizer-Aided Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed a novel adaptive equalizer-aided clock recovery algorithm for faster-than-Nyquist coherent optical systems and experimentally demonstrated good performance for Tomlinson-Harashima pre-coded 16QAM signal until 180Gbaud under the system with 10dB bandwidth of 65GHz.

articleTitle: High Efficiency Single-Sideband Modulator using Coupled Bragg Grating Resonators on Thin-Film Lithium Niobate
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an efficient single-sideband thin-film lithium niobate modulator with periodically cascaded Bragg gratings. The device achieves the highest modulation efficiency that has been reported (0.19 V/cm) with a compact phase-shifter length (542 μm).

articleTitle: Frequency-Band Analysis of Equalization Enhanced Phase Noise Jointly with DSP Impact
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The fundamental of equalization-enhanced phase noise (EEPN) jointly with the DSP impact is investigated, using an approach based on frequency-band segmentation of the frequency-noise (FN) spectrum. This approach enables to study the EEPN penalty of different FN spectral regions and correlated with its bursty nature.

articleTitle: Closed-form coherent Gaussian noise model applicable to arbitrary flexible grid and heterogeneous links
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A closed-form expression of the coherent contribution of Gaussian noise nonlinear interference is presented. This model shows good agreement with a complete Gaussian noise model and a split-step model and applies in arbitrary link configurations.

articleTitle: First Demonstration of 4×4 Distributed MIMO Communication with 3GPP-compliant 5G Smartphone utilizing SCM/WDM-Based IF-over-Fiber MFH Link
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We successfully demonstrated the real-time bi-directional 5G-compliant 4×4 Distributed-MIMO communication for the first time utilizing SCM/WDM-based IF-over-Fiber mobile fronthaul link architecture and commercially available smartphone for realizing future antenna distribution mobile communication systems.

articleTitle: Deployment of Secure Machine Learning Pipelines for Near-Real-Time Control of 6G Network Services
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A ML function orchestrator deploying secure ML pipelines to support near-real-time control of network services is demonstrated. A distributed ledger supports the initial key exchange to establish secure connectivity among the agents in the pipeline.

articleTitle: Spatio-Temporal Failure Prediction Using LSTGM for Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A Latent Spatio-Temporal Graph Model is proposed for failure prediction in optical networks, which can effectively learn both spatial and temporal distribution of real equipment performance data and achieve F1-score up to 0.9745.

articleTitle: Accelerate Distributed Deep Learning with a Fast Reconfigurable Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a fast-reconfigurable and scalable optical network architecture, which employs a flow-based transmit scheduling scheme to accelerate data parallelism in distributed deep learning. Experimental results demonstrate that the 4-node prototype achieves training times comparable to those of ideal electrical switching.

articleTitle: Integrated Neuromorphic Information Processing with Electrically-injected Microring Spiking Neuron
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate, for the first time, a CMOS-compatible electrically injected microring spiking neuron, capable of reproducibly emulating the typical neural dynamics including excitability threshold, temporal integration, refractory period, and spike inhibition.

articleTitle: Underwater Wireless Optical Communications: From the Lab Tank to the Real Sea
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper introduces the recent progress of underwater wireless optical communications (UWOC). Studies in channel dynamics and link alignment issues contribute to the mature applications of UWOC in real sea environments. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High-performance chiral mode switching device at 2 μm waveband using photonic crystal waveguide
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a silicon chiral mode switching device by dynamically encircling exceptional point at 2 μm waveband, with high purities (> 95%) for both TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> and TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> modes in a broad bandwidth (85 nm).

articleTitle: Towards Explainable Reinforcement Learning in Optical Networks: The RMSA Use Case
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an approach to extract explanations from a trained reinforcement learning agent. Our analysis over three RMSA environment variations shows how the agent uses the input information, increasing our understanding of its learned policy.

articleTitle: Photonic Frequency Hopping Driven by High-Speed Wavelength Tunable Laser for Secure Terahertz-wave Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed a photonic frequency-hopping physical-secure Terahertz-wave communication system driven by a high-speed wavelength tunable laser and a photomixer, and experimentally demonstrated a frequency-hopping time of less than 25 ns at 300-GHz band.

articleTitle: High Sampling Rate Arbitrary Waveform Generation in the Polarimetric Synthetic Dimension
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: High sampling rate arbitrary waveforms generated in the polarimetric synthetic dimension based on a fiber-optic system is proposed. A triangular, rectangular, and sawtooth waveform at a sampling rate of 80 GSa/s are experimentally generated.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Hitless OCS Provision for Multi-modal Traffic in a Centralized Scheduling Hybrid Optical/Electrical Datacenter Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a hitless OCS provision in a centralized scheduling hybrid optical/electrical datacenter network through a real-time FPGA-based testbed. Experimental results show that it achieves a low packet delay and flow completion time accelerations.

articleTitle: Wavelength Reconfigurable Transceiver For Multi-Interface Compute Accelerator Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a multi-port reconfigurable silicon photonic transceiver for flexible bandwidth reallocation in multi-interface architectures. We demonstrate on-chip wavelength reconfiguration on a optical testbed and show 94% job completion time improvement in large-scale network simulations.

articleTitle: Delay-minimized Distributed Sequence Routing for Satellite Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A sequence routing algorithm based geographical information is proposed to reduce delay in satellite optical networks. The simulation results show that compared with the static topological routing algorithm, the average delay is reduced by 30%.

articleTitle: Pass-Through ELSFP with Optional Integrated Optical Mux and Demux for Colorless CPO Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel type of Pass-Through ELSFP module configuration with (or without) integrated optical Mux and Demux, potentially enabling a WDM "colored" (or "colorless") system through a Colorless DR-type optical engine.

articleTitle: A Versatile Point-to-Point Network Architecture with Multi-Rate Adaptability from 100 Gbit/s to 10 Gbit/s
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: PtP networks are optimized with optical switch and extended reach (25-50 km) to another CO to allow flexible bandwidth and power consumption. Different transmission capacities and scenarios are experimented with a DFB, from 100 Gbit/s to 10 Gbit/s with/without FEC and SOA.

articleTitle: Low-Complexity Experimental Model for Submarine Link Performance Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a low-complexity experimental model that predicts the OSNR of submarine links, considering both EDFA homogeneous and inhomogeneous responses. We tested it with random input pre-emphases, obtaining a mean RMSE of 0.29 dB after 24 spans when trained with simple single-span datasets.

articleTitle: Tbps IM/DD Transmission over 10 km SMF with O-Band Quantum Dot Laser Comb for DCIs
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a record-high Tbps DWDM transmission over 10km using a packaged 1.3 µm InAs/InGaAs quantum dot comb laser. The BER below the HD-FEC level is achieved for 1.4 Tbps PAM4 and 1 Tbps PS-PAM8 transmissions.

articleTitle: A 4×112Gbps Compact Polarization-Insensitive Silicon Photonic WDM Receiver
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 4×112Gbps polarization-insensitive silicon photonic WDM receiver with a two-dimensional grating coupler, cascaded dual-ring filters and bidirectional photodiodes is demonstrated. A polarization-dependent loss of 0.45dB is achieved.

articleTitle: Liquid Cooling for Optical Networking Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This article provides insights into a successful upgrade of an air-cooled coherent metro router into a Hybrid Liquid/Air-cooled system. Additionally, an innovative solution is presented for integrating liquid-cooling into the body of pluggable optical modules.

articleTitle: Co-propagation of Classical and Continuous-variable QKD Signals over a Turbulent Optical Channel with a Real-time QKD Receiver
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate classical and quantum signal co-propagation over a turbulent free-space channel with 3 Tbit/s throughput and record 2.7 Mbit/s secret-key rate. Our real-time GPU-based receiver assessed quantum signal integrity under different turbulence scenarios for the first time.

articleTitle: 45.7 Tb/s over 12 053 km Transmission with an All-Multi-Core Recirculating-Loop 4-Core-Fiber System
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 45.7Tb/s transmission of 4×175×24.5 GBd DP-QPSK signals over 12053km of four-core fiber using multi-core C-band EDFAs and Raman amplification. This is the first all-multi-core component recirculating-loop-based long-haul transmission system.

articleTitle: Field Implementation of Fiber Cable Monitoring for Mesh Networks with Optimized Multi-Channel Sensor Placement
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We develop a heuristic solution to effectively optimize the placement of multi-channel distributed fiber optic sensors in mesh optical fiber cable networks. The solution has been implemented in a field network to provide continuous monitoring.

articleTitle: Add-drop Multiplexing for Spectrally Overlapped Nonlinear Frequency Division Multiplexed Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present an add-drop multiplexer for WDM nonlinear frequency division multiplexed transmission systems, capable of replacing channels in a modulated spectrum that uses spectral overlap to stitch the nonlinear spectrum to avoid guard bands.

articleTitle: Over 3 THz Real-Time Optical Vector Oscilloscope
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a real-time optical vector oscilloscope to obtain full-field information with over 3-THz acquisition bandwidth. The experiments demonstrate 80 gigabit/s OOK and BPSK signals, and 2×160 gigabit/s QPSK wavelength-division multiplexed signals are simultaneously observed.

articleTitle: Distributed strain sensing by optical frequency domain reflectometry with longest common substring algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a spectrum shift extraction method in optical frequency domain reflectometry based on longest common substring algorithm, allowing for an improvement in the accuracy and the range over 56% of the effective sweep range.

articleTitle: C-band Net 1.8 Tb/s (240Gb/s/λ× 8λ) DWDM IM/DD Transmission over 1.4km AR-HCF with Linear FFE Only
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Record net 1.8Tb/s IM/DD optical interconnect supported by 8λ dense wavelength division multiplexing technique in C-band over wide-band low dispersion anti-resonant hollow-core fibre (AR-HCF) is experimentally demonstrated under 6.7% HD-FEC limit with linear FFE only.

articleTitle: Transoceanic-Class WDM/SDM Transmission of PDM-QPSK Signals over Coupled 12-Core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated long-haul transmission of 32-Gbaud PDM-QPSK over coupled 12-core fiber with standard cladding diameter. Error-free transmission after FEC was achieved up to 7280 km. The estimated rms MDL per 52-km span was 0.3 dB.

articleTitle: A Cost-efficient 1.28 Tb/s DWDM Receiver using All-Si Double Microring Avalanche Photodiodes
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel 8-channel all-Si double-MRR RX with record-high 1.28 Tb/s aggregated data rate and ultra-low -50 dB crosstalk, which can compete with the commercial RXs and promises ~ 40% chip cost saving.

articleTitle: Band aggregators for band-unaware multi-band CDC-ROADM
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on the concept of a multi-band CDC-ROADM network without network operators being aware of the differences between bands and its enabling devices, i.e., band aggregators.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Robust Mobile Free Space Optical System using High-speed Beam Tracking and 2D-PDA-based Spatial-Diversity Reception
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show the first-ever live demonstration of a robust mobile free space optical system using three-stage high-speed beam tracking technology including 2-dimensional photodetector array based spatial diversity combining, which enables the mobility support in 6G.

articleTitle: Low-Complexity Frequency Packing to Enable Filtering-Tolerant DSCM Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Employing optimized frequency packing over digital subcarrier multiplexing (DSCM), we exploit the mitigation of WSS filtering penalties. After transmitting a 60 Gbaud 8-DSCM with 0.2 roll-off over 5-10 WSSs, we experimentally demonstrate OSNR gains of >3 dB, without additional DSP complexity.

articleTitle: Environmentally Stable Ultra-Low Noise Self-Injection Locked Semiconductor Lasers
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Self-injection locking (SIL) of semiconductor lasers by means of monolithic optical cavities allow generation of high spectral purity and high stability optical signals under varying environmental conditions. We review recent advances in the field and focus at the SIL by means of monolithic Fabry-Perot resonators.

articleTitle: Low-Divergent 940-nm Photonic-Crystal Surface-Emitting Laser for Short-Reach Free-Space Data Link
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The photonic-crystal-structured surface-emitting laser with a low-divergent-beam angle of 4.5 mrad can perform either 5.5-Gbit/s NRZ-OOK, or 16-Gbit/s broadband QAM DMT or 19.2-Gbit/s bit-loaded DMT formats for 30-cm short-reach point-to-point free-space-optical communication link.

articleTitle: Photonic Integrated Circuits for Space Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a hybrid integrated microwave photonic (iMWP) chip platform where Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4-</inf>based-TriPleX and InP optical waveguides are combined to enable broadband and high frequency radio signal processing. An iMWP beamformer for phased array antenna systems will be presented.

articleTitle: Efficient Two Photon Absorption for 400-nm Remote Optical Control at 2-μm Waveband in a Low-loss Multimode Silicon Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Efficient TPA for 400-nm range remote control at 2-μm waveband is experimentally realized with 8.9-dB ER by C-band pump using a low-loss multimode silicon waveguide, indicating fully utilized advantages at both C and 2-μm wavebands.

articleTitle: On-chip InP/LiNbO3 microcomb laser
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a chip-scale InP/LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> laser that directly emits mode-locked microcomb on demand, with spectral bandwidth ~ 50 nm, individual comb linewidth ∼ 600 Hz, frequency tuning rate > 2.4 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</sup> Hz/s, and 100% utilization of optical power for comb generation.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of In-Field 400G Coherent Metro-Access Convergence
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present an experimental demonstration and analytical scaling of optically amplified metro combined with PON access transmission over installed fibers, using coherent 50GBaud PM-16QAM and discuss the technical feasibility of future 400G metro-access convergence.

articleTitle: W-band Wireless Transmission based on 98 GHz Packaged Silicon Photonics Optical Clock Generator
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A fully packaged CMOS-compatible photonic integrated frequency-tunable optical clock synthesizer is used for 93 GHz wireless transmission of complex modulation formats up to 4 Gb/s data rate, with noise performance suitable for upcoming 6G networks.

articleTitle: Autoencoder Learning of Constellation Shaping Robust to Semiconductor Laser Noise and Nonlinearity in Fiber-THz System
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the robustness of autoencoder-based constellation shaping against semiconductor laser noise and nonlinearity. Up to 46% lower BER and 1.5 dB gain are achieved in the fiber-THz system at 320 GHz.

articleTitle: Enhancing Generalization in Neural Channel Model for Optical Fiber WDM Transmission through Learned Encoding of System Parameters
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a learned encoding method to enhance neural channel model generalization by integrating system parameters as side information. This approach achieves large-scale generalization, encompassing optical fiber transmission launch power and distance.

articleTitle: Mode Division Multiplexed Coherent Optical Transmission in Time Domain by Using Higher-order Hermite-Gaussian Pulses
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a new mode-division-multiplexing (MDM) technique in time-domain using higher-order Hermite-Gaussian pulses. 32-QAM, 450-km MDM transmission was successfully demonstrated with HG<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>, HG<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>, HG<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, and HG<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> pulses, where the time-domain orthogonality was used for demultiplexing.

articleTitle: Polarization-insensitive, silicon-photonics circuit, four-mode spatial multiplexer matched to a rectangular core fiber
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We design and test a SiPh mode multiplexer circuit, utilizing 3µm-thick ridge waveguides having low polarization dependence. The multiplexer achieves low loss (2-3dB) and low PDL (<0.8dB) across the C-band. Output modes are coupled to rectangular core fiber.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Lightwave Fabrics for ML Supercomputers
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present the large-scale, production deployment of reconfigurable Lightwave Fabrics (LWF) for Machine Learning (ML) supercomputers. These fabrics consist of a custom developed optical circuit switch (OCS), circulators, and WDM transceiver technologies. The use of a LWF dramatically enhances the current generation 4096 tensor processing unit (TPU) system in both availability (up to 3x) as well as performance (up to 3.3x) with modest power and cost increases (1% and 6%, respectively).

articleTitle: Rate-flexible hybrid constellation shaping for polar-coded 32QAM in FSO systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a rate-flexible hybrid constellation shaping for polar-coded 32QAM in FSO systems, which can improve the Q factor by 0.72~1.53dB at different data rates over weak turbulence channels.

articleTitle: Performance comparison of QD-SOA, QW-SOA, Bulk-SOA and PDFA for multi-Tbps O-band WDM links
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally compare QD-SOA to QW-SOA, bulk-SOA, and PDFA for coherent and IM/DD in the O-band at 10 km. A 1.152 Tbps/λ WDM coherent transmission is achieved with the QD-SOA.

articleTitle: Multi-channel system with high-performance fractal superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on an eight-channel fractal SNSPD system in the wavelength range of 940 nm with minimal polarization sensitivity. The best channel exhibits 96% system detection efficiency and 19 cps dark-count rate.

articleTitle: Optical Fiber Bendable at 3-mm Diameter for Optical Transceivers and Silicon Photonic Packaging
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 3-mm diameter bendable and mechanically reliable fiber for both O- and C-band wavelength windows is designed and fabricated. Bending losses of 0.036 dB/turn at 1310 nm and 0.39 dB/turn at 1550 nm are demonstrated.

articleTitle: First Demonstration of 200-G Coherent PON at O-band with Heterogeneously-Integrated SiP Tx and Rx with Lasers
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first 200-G O-band coherent PON using a heterogeneously-integrated SiP PIC transmitter as an OLT and PIC/EIC receivers as ONUs. A joint DSCM and NOMA scheme is presented for flexibly dense access scenarios.

articleTitle: Wideband S, C,+ L-Band Comb Regeneration in Large-Scale Few-Mode MCF Link with Single-Mode Seed Channel
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We use wideband optical frequency combs covering 134 nm to transmit >336 Tb/s in a single core of a 3-mode multi-core fiber with seed transmission to regenerate synchronized local comb enabling simplified coherent reception.

articleTitle: Local Wind Impact Sensing using State of Polarization Measurement on a Live Short-Haul Aerial Fibre Cable
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A short aerial cable spun on a high-voltage line is used to monitor wind-induced stress on the cable infrastructure. Span-by-span localized early warnings may be issued based on the state of polarization transients.

articleTitle: The Opportunities and Challenges of EuroQCI
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: EuroQCI, the European Quantum Communication Infrastructure, is one of the most ambitious security initiatives in Europe. We will present the status and discuss challenges and opportunities.

articleTitle: Heterogenous InP Electro-Absorption Modulator with Si Waveguides for Beyond 200 Gbps/λ Optical Interconnects
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an InP EAM with Si waveguides and achieve 256 Gbaud OOK, 170 Gbaud PAM4, 150 Gbaud PAM6, and 120 Gbaud PAM8 transmission over 500 meters of SMF below 6.25% OH HD-FEC threshold.

articleTitle: Fabrication-Tolerant High-Speed 5-bit Silicon Optical True Time Delay Line In the O-band
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated a high-speed 5-bit silicon optical true time delay line based on fabrication-tolerant electro-optic push-pull optical switches, which shows a lower phase deviation and a lower insertion loss compared with the conventional design.

articleTitle: Towards international clock comparisons on a telecom network: ultrastable optical frequency transfer over deployed multi-core fiber
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present optical frequency transfer over deployed multi-core fiber at levels that support the world’s best optical clocks for the first time, achieving fractional frequency stability better than 3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-19</sup> through 25.2 km of fiber.

articleTitle: Semi-Analytical Methodology for Advanced Filter Design in Chirped-Managed Lasers
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce a novel semi-analytical method for the deterministic design of advanced optical filters in chirped-managed lasers (CMLs), enhancing transmission reach for access networks. This approach can be applied to any baud rate of NRZ and PAM-4, overcoming previous trial-and-error methods.

articleTitle: 1.024-Tbit/s CDM-SDM Coherent PON over 10-km Weakly-Coupled MCF
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 1.024-Tbit/s CDM-SDM coherent PON is experimentally demonstrated based on weakly-coupled MCFs and Walsh code assignment. Space-time coding is utilized for balancing the inconsistency of the reception performances of CDM-assigned ONUs.

articleTitle: Cryogenic Oxide-VCSEL at 2.8 K Demonstrates Record Bandwidth f-3dB > 50 GHz, Pout > 14 mW and PAM-4 Data Rate up to 128 Gb/s
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report record speed-power and ultrahigh linearity performance for a 6.8 um oxide-aperture VCSEL operated at 2.8 K. The device demonstrates data rate up to 128 Gb/s PAM-4 and 64 Gb/s NRZ.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Single-wavelength net 16.1Tb/s Self-Homodyne Coherent Transmission over a 24-Core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the transmission of 102-Gbaud DP-16QAM signals over a 2.7km 24-core fiber in the SDM-SHD system, employing MHz-linewidth DFB laser and FIFO devices based on femtosecond laser direct writing technique.

articleTitle: Silicon Carbide Soliton Microcomb Generation for Narrow-grid Optical Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate efficient soliton microcomb generation in silicon carbide microresonators with a record-low on-chip pump power of 6.5 mW. The microcomb exhibits a near 100 GHz free spectral range, enabling its application in optical communications.

articleTitle: On the Accuracy of Power Profile Estimation using MMSE or Deconvoluted Correlation-Based Profiles
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We evaluate the accuracy of the deconvolution of the longitudinal power profile computed using correlation-based method. We show that we obtain a similar accuracy to the MMSE approach in different cases.

articleTitle: Port-Agnostic Path Establishment with Point-to-Multipoint Control of Remote User Terminals for Metro/Access-Integrated All-Photonics Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a port-agnostic initial-connection sequence allowing simultaneous connection of multiple user terminals (UTs), and demonstrate end-to-end wavelength-path and fiber-path establishment for DWDM and non-DWDM UTs through point-to-multipoint-type remote UT control in Metro/Access-Integrated All-Photonics Network.

articleTitle: Double-stage Carrier Frequency Offset Estimation Using the Eigenvalue and Scattering Coefficient b in the Nonlinear Fourier Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel method to estimate the carrier frequency offset (CFO) using the eigenvalue and scattering coefficient b in the NFT. Our experiments demonstrate fine CFO estimation below 10 kHz for the proposed method. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Non-Destructive Characterization of Hollow Core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We summarize our recent work developing a technique for accurate and nondestructive measurement of the microstructure geometry of nested and double nested antiresonant fibers. We present results showing microstructure variation along a 2.2 km fiber.

articleTitle: Optimal Nonlinear Spectral Back-Rotation for Discrete Eigenvalue NFT Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose back rotating the nonlinear spectral phase by half of the transmission distance as a computationally simple impairment compensation algorithm for discrete eigenvalue NFT transmission systems.

articleTitle: Accurate Beyond-400G Transmitter Quality Metric Based on Transmitter Constellation Closure Measurement
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the use of transmitter constellation closure (TCC) for accurate quality assessment of beyond-400G coherent transmitters, and show its tolerance to inter-symbol interference and phase noise with and without probability constellation shaping (PCS).

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional-Printed hollow Fabry-Perot fiber sensor for ultra-high sensitivity ultrasound detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a hollow Fabry-Perot (FP) fiber sensor fabricated by 3D-printing technology for highly sensitive ultrasound detection. The sensor has a sensitivity of 167 mV/kPa which is 38 times higher than a solid FP fiber sensor.

articleTitle: Fully integrated silicon photonic high-speed transmitter with Ring-Assisted Mach-Zehnder modulator
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a fully integrated transmitter which includes a DFB laser and a push-pull drive ring-assisted Mach-Zehnder modulator. We demonstrate 224Gb/s PAM-4 transmission with 1.8Vppd differential driving swing and transmitter penalty (TDECQ) of 1.25dB.

articleTitle: Fast Online Optimization of Multi-pump Raman Amplifiers for Field Deployment in Multi-band Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate Raman amplifier optimization with fast pump deviation inference in different scenarios. Using less than 3 new data, accurate gain generation is achieved with low root mean square error (<0.1 dB).

articleTitle: Nonlinear SNR Estimation based on Power Profile Estimation in Hybrid Raman-EDFA Link
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the nonlinear SNR estimation based on longitudinal power profile obtained with coherent receiver. The estimation error is less than 0.6 dB in WDM transmission over hybrid Raman-EDFA link.

articleTitle: 400 Gbps/λ DP-16QAM O-band Link with SiP TX and RX PICs using only Heterogeneously Integrated Lasers and SOAs for Optical Gain
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the first net 400 Gbps/λ O-band coherent, dual-polarization, 60 Gbaud 16QAM link using SiP TX/RX PICs with heterogeneously integrated lasers, operating below the 15% overhead SD-FEC limit over 2 km without external amplifiers.

articleTitle: Modeling the Input Power Dependency of Transceiver BER-ONSR for QoT Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a method to estimate the input power dependency of the transceiver BER-OSNR characteristic. Experiments using commercial transceivers show that estimation error in Q-factor is less than 0.2 dB.

articleTitle: Efficient Inter-Channel Interference Monitoring using DSP in Standard Coherent Receivers
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an efficient Optical Performance Monitoring algorithm, based on a Machine Learning-assisted Digital Signal Processing scheme suitable for standard coherent receivers, for estimating asymmetric cross-talk between adjacent WDM channels.

articleTitle: Dual-Polarization Phase Retrieval Receiver in Silicon Photonics
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated dual-polarization phase retrieval receiver. It uses silicon waveguides and resonators to recover phase from intensity-only measurements. We show retrieval of a polarization-division multiplexed 30-GBd QPSK signal over 80 km of SSMF.

articleTitle: Preamble Design for Joint Frame Synchronization, Frequency Offset Estimation and Channel Estimation in Burst Mode Coherent PONs
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a preamble jointly achieving frame synchronization, frequency offset and channel estimation for burst-mode detection in coherent PON. The DSP converges within a 272-symbol preamble in a 15 GBaud experiment.

articleTitle: Hollow Core DNANF Optical Fiber with <0.11 dB/km Loss
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the fabrication of a hollow-core DNANF with a geometry extensively optimized for minimum loss. Three independent loss measurements average 0.08±0.03 dB/km at 1550 nm, the lowest attenuation ever achieved in an optical fiber.

articleTitle: Enhanced Carrier Phase Recovery for Spectral-efficient Digital Subcarrier Multiplexing Transmissions
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a performance enhanced carrier-phase-recovery (CPR) method for spectral-efficient digital-subcarrier-multiplexing transmissions with two-interleaved-pilot-tones. By reconstructing and compensating transmitter-side and receiver-side laser phase noises separately, equalization-enhance-phase-noise (EEPN) can be circumvented.

articleTitle: Interleaved Dielectric-Metal Plasmonic Grating Polarizer
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate novel metasurface optics leveraging the interaction of interleaved dielectric and metal plasmonic subwavelength gratings. A flat polarizer with high extinction ratio and high transmission for a wide angle of incidence is reported.

articleTitle: Low Threshold and 10kHz-Class Narrow Linewidth 1.55 µm-Band Quantum Dot Laser Diode on InP(311)B Substrate
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated low threshold current of 8.8 mA and 15.0 mA in pulsed and CW operation, and the extremely narrow linewidth of 12.2 kHz at room temperature in a fabricated 1.55 μm-band QD-DFB-LD.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Neural Heterogeneity with Programmable Brain-Inspired Optoelectronic Spiking Neurons
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Neural heterogeneity enables spiking neural networks to implement complex functions with fewer neurons. We designed, simulated, and demonstrated programmable optoelectronic spiking neurons that can achieve multiple neuron characteristics based on external tuning voltages.

articleTitle: High-Density Weakly-Coupled 4-core MCF with 160-μm Coating for O-band Application
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We developed weakly coupled 4-core multi-core fiber with 100-μm cladding and 160μm coating suitable for O-band applications, which achieves an impressive core density of 9.8 times higher than that of conventional single-core fiber.

articleTitle: Real-Time Urban Sensing by In-Fiber Interferometric System over Field-Deployed Uncoupled 4-Core Fiber Cable
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate urban anthropic events monitoring through a sustainable and cost-effective interferometer sensor built by exploiting two cores of an uncoupled 4-core fiber in the first deployed multi-core fiber cable in L’Aquila, Italy.

articleTitle: Large-scale integrated focal plane array for two-dimensional scanning
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The focal plane array is regarded as a promising solution for LiDAR. In this work, we present an ultra-large-scale focal plane array featuring 1024 antennas and 2113 micro-rings with a FoV of 85.7° × 29.5°.

articleTitle: Large-range and Seamless Rate-Adaptive Free-Space Optical System Based on Rate Compatible Modulation
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A large-range and seamless rate-adaptive FSO scheme based on rate compatible modulation is proposed. Experimental results show that it can adaptively vary the rate from 6.7Gbps to 53.6Gbps within ~15 dB received optical power range.

articleTitle: Parametric Oscillators and Soliton Combs in Bandgap-detuned Nanoresonators
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report controllable generation of OPO lasers and soliton microcombs by manipulating nonlinear dynamics with nanophotonic bandgaps. By excitation detuned from bandgap modes, we realize wide-tunability, low-threshold-power and high-conversion-efficiency lasers.

articleTitle: A physical-layer Rogue ONU identification method based on hardware fingerprint technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a method for identifying rogue ONUs based on hardware fingerprint technology. By directly detecting waveform fingerprints, the experimental results show that the average identification accuracy within 16 ONUs can reach 96.74%.

articleTitle: Neural Network with Optical Frequency-Coded ReLU
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a photonic rectified linear unit (ReLU) function accomplished through frequency-coded neural signals. We show operation of an optical neuron with weighted sum and ReLU activation to perform with a 1% penalty in accuracy.

articleTitle: Fully-blind Neural Network Based Equalization for Severe Nonlinear Distortions in 112 Gbit/s Passive Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate and evaluate a fully-blind digital signal processing (DSP) chain for 100G passive optical networks (PONs), and analyze different equalizer topologies based on neural networks with low hardware complexity.

articleTitle: A 64 Gb/s NRZ O-Band Ring Modulator with 3.2 THz FSR for DWDM Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the highest BW-FSR product O-band Si microring modulator to date. The device achieves 3.2 THz FSR, 41 GHz BW, 44 pm/V modulation efficiency, and operates at 64 Gb/s NRZ. © 2024 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Mechanism and First Experimental Demonstration of ILMD-induced Reduction of Intramodal Cross-phase Modulation in Weakly-coupled FMF Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We for the first time experimentally analyze the interaction between intramodal XPM and ILMD effects in weakly-coupled FMF, and prove that the ILMD could be a major factor for effectively reducing the intramodal XPM impairments.

articleTitle: 205.8Tb/s Weakly-Coupled 2-Mode 7-Core Transmission Over 1170-km FM-MCF Only Using 2×2 MIMO-DSP
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first long-haul weakly-coupled FM-MCF transmission adopting non-degenerate LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</inf> and LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">02</inf> modes in a 6-LP-mode 7-core fiber. 205.8Tb/s throughput over 1170 km transmission with DP-QPSK modulation is achieved only utilizing 2×2 MIMO-DSP.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient Cladding-pumped Amplifier for Coupled Multi-core Fiber Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review energy-efficient cladding-pumped multi-core amplification technologies and experimentally demonstrate the advantages of using a coupled-12-core amplifier for improving the amplification efficiency.

articleTitle: First Demonstration of a Group-IV Emitter on Photonic BiCMOS Supplying a Quantum Communication Link
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We implement a silicon-on-insulator light emitter as optical supply for a QKD transmitter and transfer it to an electronic BiCMOS wafer. A secure key is established over short reach in co-existence with shortwave data transmission.

articleTitle: 6.48 Tb/s Transmissions Using 50 GHz Integrated Lithium Niobate Flat-Top Electro-Optic Combs
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 6.48 Tb/s transmission using 50-GHz integrated lithium niobate flat-top electro-optic (EO) combs over a 53-km field-deployed link and show their flexibility in generating combs with variable frequency spacing and using multiple laser sources.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of 51.2 Tb/s Self-Homodyne Coherent Interconnects on a 3D Photonic Chip Inspiring Coherent Technology Transfer to Centimeter-Scale Ultra-Short-Reach Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated a record net 51.2 Tb/s (800Gb/s PDM-64QAM x 64 Channels) ultrafast laser inscribed 3D photonic chip interconnects based on self-homodyne coherent detection, showing the feasibility of coherent technology transfer to ultra-short-reach applications.

articleTitle: Interoperable Coherent WDM interfaces at 400G and 800G
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 400G coherent WDM interfaces were recently standardized by multi-source agreement and standardization forums to enable interoperable operation across DCI, metro/regional and IPoWDM networks of transceivers from various vendors with DSP of different suppliers. The work is under progress for 800G WDM interfaces with the objective to deal with the same use cases at 800G as at 400G. OpenROADM is elaborating for the first time an interoperable probabilistic constellation shaping specification that addresses this need.

articleTitle: Integrated Optical Parametric Amplifier with Record Gain
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report an innovative phase-sensitive optical amplification using GeSbS microresonators, obtaining 31.5 dB gain with 8.5 mW CW-pump power in phase-insensitive mode, a 4.95 dB additional gain and 18.9 dB extinction ratio in phase-sensitive mode.

articleTitle: Cost-effective ROADM Using Wide-bandwidth Silicon Tunable Ring Filter for Drop Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We develop a ROADM using an 8-channel integrated polarization-insensitive, wide-bandwidth silicon tunable ring-filter for signal drop. A 75-GHz-spaced 60-channel 200-Gb/s DP-QPSK signal is transmitted over 640 km (8 span × 80 km) without any penalty.

articleTitle: Direct Measurement of Resonant Phonon Modes in Optical Fibers
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We probe and model phonon modes in optical fibre by means of frequency noise measurements of distributed-feedback fibre lasers. Resonant acoustic waves with femtometer-scale amplitudes are fully characterised as they interact with the optical cavity.

articleTitle: Distributed Multi-Agent System fed with Telemetry Data for Near-Real-Time Service Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Near-real-time routing decisions on multiple flows will be demonstrated. Decision making is based on precise end-to-end delay telemetry processed by a P4 collector. Distribution of roles will exhibit reduced response times to provide multi-objective operation.

articleTitle: Highly rectangular SCL-band MUX/DEMUX filter using compact cascaded arrayed waveguide gratings
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a small-footprint arrayed-waveguide grating (AWG) design method in which an arrayed waveguide area serves as an evaluation metric and report a 170-nm-wide and highly rectangular waveband MUX/DEMUX filter using compact cascaded AWGs.

articleTitle: Enhanced Recurrent Neural Network Equalization based on Hidden Feature Extraction Learning for Optical Interconnect
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a hidden feature extraction learning method for RNN equalization to improve training efficiency without increasing computational burden. Superior BER is demonstrated in 288 Gb/s 100 m VCSEL-MMF interconnect compared with black-box training strategy.

articleTitle: Expanded Gain-Switched Comb Source for 180 – 260 GHz Sub-THz Analog Radio-over-Fiber 6G Wireless System
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the successful generation and transmission of low-subcarrier spacing (up to 500 kHz) 6G compatible sub-THz OFDM signals in the 180 to 260 GHz frequency band using an expanded gain-switched laser comb source and waveguide-integrated photodiode antenna.

articleTitle: Moore’s Law Redefined for AI/HPC
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Examining the impact of AI workloads on system performance, we reapply Moore’s law at the system level to uncover the implications for photonic components and the drivers that will propel the photonic industry forward.

articleTitle: A Novel Machine Learning-based Equalizer for a Downstream 100G PAM-4 PON
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A frequency-calibrated SCINet (FC-SCINet) equalizer is proposed for downstream 100G PON with 28.7 dB path loss. At 5 km, FC-SCINet improves the BER by 88.87% compared to FFE and a 3-layer DNN with 10.57% lower complexity.

articleTitle: Continuous Distributed Phase and Polarization Monitoring of Trans-Atlantic Submarine Fiber Optic Cable
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We perform submarine cable environmental sensing using an FPGA+GPU-based real-time polarization-resolved coherent OFDR prototype. Measurements of earthquake waves propagating across the Atlantic Ocean are recorded simultaneously at >70 evenly distributed points along the cable.

articleTitle: Real-Time Demonstration of Anomalous Vibrations Detection in a Metro-like Environment using a SOP-based Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the real-time applicability of SOP-based anomalous vibrations detection. The proposed demo will engage the audience by showing the time evolution of two proposed metrics, with user-set parameters and different fiber-induced mechanical vibrations.

articleTitle: Photonic switched networking for data centers and advanced computing systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We explore optical switching to extend network programmability to the physical layer. We present applications of our Layer-1 SDN for improving fabric resilience against hardware failures and saving network power and cost in Deep-Learning training.

articleTitle: 40-GHz Bandwidth Envelope Detector Used in 0.3-THz IM/DD System for 4096-QAM DSM Signal Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a photonics-aided THz IM/DD transmission system using a large-bandwidth envelope detector and delta-sigma modulation. The proposed system can support 4096-QAM DSM modulation and simple and low-cost receiver architecture.

articleTitle: Availability-Guaranteed Differentiated Provisioning in Integrated Satellite-Terrestrial Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper investigates differentiated provisioning in integrated satellite-terrestrial optical networks. Two connection availability models are developed considering network dynamic nature. Two availability-guaranteed differentiated provisioning algorithms are proposed. Their effectiveness is verified by numerical results.

articleTitle: E-band transmission of 30-Gbaud PM-16-QAM supported by Neodymium-Doped Fiber Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the first E-band transmission through 50 km of G.652.D fiber using 30 Gbaud 16-QAM signals enabled by a neodymium doped fiber amplifier with 14 dB gain and 5 dB noise figure.

articleTitle: Heterogeneously-Integrated Self-injection Locked Lasers on Thin Film Lithium Niobate
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a heterogeneously integrated self-injection locked lithium niobate laser via direct bonding. The single mode lasing power is as high as 16 mW with a side mode suppression ratio over 50 dB. © 2023 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 200G IM/DD Time-and-Polarization-Division-Multiplexed PON with >29dB Power Budget Using Boosted EML and APDs
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally show feasibility of downstream 200 Gbit/s IM/DD TPDM PON system with >4 dB margin to 29 dB optical power budget based on two 100 Gbit/s polarization channels in a single wavelength window. The system uses SBS suppression to mitigate nonlinear fiber loss and duoternary modulation to overcome bandwidth limitation.

articleTitle: 32×100 GHz WDM filter based on ultra-compact silicon rings with a high thermal tuning efficiency of 5.85 mW/π
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: To the best of our knowledge, this paper has achieved the lowest thermal tuning power (5.85 mW/π) for silicon rings with FSR≥3.2 THz, and the first silicon ring-based WDM-32×100 GHz filter.

articleTitle: Standard Coating Diameter Uncoupled 19-Core Multicore Fiber with Highest Core Density for Optical Wiring
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 19-core MCF with standard coating diameter was fabricated. Highest core density was achieved compared with that of reported uncoupled MCFs using homogeneous cores. r=7.5mm bending can be applied to the MCF with certain mechanical reliability.

articleTitle: Field Detection and Localization of Digging Excavator Events using MIMO Digital Fiber Sensing over a Deployed Optical Network for Proactive Fiber Break Prevention
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the detection and localization of the perturbations induced by a jackhammer and an excavator over a buried fiber cable from an operational optical network thanks to high sensitivity Multiple-Input-Multiple-Output digital fiber sensing.

articleTitle: Privacy Preserving Digital Twin Knowledge Sharing for Multi-domain Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Knowledge sharing techniques among OCATA optical layer digital twin instances are proposed for multi-domain scenarios. Intra-domain model transformations are performed to guarantee privacy of intra-domain topology. Remarkable accuracy to estimate multi-domain lightpaths QoT is shown.

articleTitle: Quantum Key Management System with Dynamic Routing for Meshed QKD Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: For an emulated QKD network, a decentralized key management system is automatically deployed as VNF. We show that dynamic key re-routing overcomes failures in the key distribution layer of meshed QKD-secured OTNs under realistic conditions.

articleTitle: 112 Gbaud optical PAM8 modulation based on segmented thin film lithium niobate modulator
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an optical transmission of 112 Gbaud PAM8 based on a segmented thin film lithium niobate modulator in an IMDD link. The Vpp of two single-ended RF signals are 2.5V and 3.5 V.

articleTitle: Ten-Channel High Power DFB Laser Array with High Single Mode Stability and Low RIN
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A high power 10-channel single-mode DFB laser array with 200-GHz-spacing is demonstrated. Output power over 85mW, SMSR over 55dB and RIN below -155dBc/Hz have been realized for all channels of the fabricated laser array.

articleTitle: 100 Gbps WDM OWC Link Performance Using IMOS Surface Grating Coupler and Commercial Fiber Receivers
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose the use of an IMOS surface grating coupler for light collection and commercial pigtailed receivers for light detection in short-link OWC system. We demonstrate error-free OOK transmission of four 25 Gbps WDM channels.

articleTitle: Filter-Less Synthesis of 50-GHz Double-Spaced Flat Optical Comb by In-phase/Quadrature Electro-Optic Modulator for High Bandwidth Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 50-GHz spaced flat optical comb is experimentally generated in the electro-optic modulation process by using an IQM driven with 25 GHz signals. We demonstrate that the double-frequency-spaced comb effectively carries multi-channel 5x28 Gbaud signals.

articleTitle: Composable finite size key generation in a polarization diverse continuous variable quantum key distribution system
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on a polarization diverse continuous variable quantum key distribution system. Composable finite size key generation was assessed using 7.6×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> quantum states measured over 20 random states of polarization, secret key generation was achieved with 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> states.

articleTitle: No-guard-band integration of digital coherent CV-QKD system into 400 Gbit/s 75 GHz grid DWDM systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated no-guard-band integration of a digital coherent Continuous-variable QKD system into OpenZR<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-compliant DWDM transmission systems. The estimated secret key rate was 19.9 kbit/s over a 75 km EDFA amplified SMF link.

articleTitle: Intra-datacenter Optical Circuit Switch Architecture with Multi-band Transmission Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper proposes an optical circuit switch architecture using multi-band transmission. We experimentally confirmed the performance of 1,280×1,280 switch with 32-Gbaud dual-polarization QPSK signals aligned on 33-GHz grid in the C- and L- bands.

articleTitle: Photon-counting laser ranging with dual-comb asynchronous optical sampling
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on laser ranging using dual-comb asynchronous optical sampling and a fractal SNSPD, achieving ranging precision of 7.7 micrometer and 65 nm with acquisition time of 1 ms and 1 s, respectively.

articleTitle: Uncooled Operation of Directly Modulated Membrane Laser with Buried Sapphire Layer on Si Substrate
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A membrane laser with a buried sapphire layer on Si has 3-dB bandwidths of 40-25 GHz at 25-80°C. The laser demonstrates 80-Gbit/s PAM4 operations up to 80°C at an energy cost of 0.77 pJ/bit.

articleTitle: Role of Frequency-Resolved SNR in Entropy-Loading DMT Systems: Rate Comparison and Simplified Options
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We verify that frequency-resolved SNR is crucial to approach the capacity of a discrete-multitone system with entropy loading (EL), and propose several methods to reduce the complexity of EL while keeping the SNR information to minimize the rate penalty.

articleTitle: Si-SiN-SiN Tri-Layer Strictly Non-blocking 8×8 Microring-Based Optical Switch
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a Si-SiN-SiN tri-layer switch-and-select 8×8 optical switch with 128 thermally-driven microring-resonators. Crosstalk ratio and on-chip loss are measured in the range of -33.2 to -50.8dB and 2.1 to 10.5dB, respectively, with >70GHz passband.

articleTitle: Demonstration of On-Chip Optical Frequency Comb Generation and Optical Injection Locking
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate for the first time a photonic integrated circuit comprising an optical frequency comb generation unit and an optical injection locking unit, as part of a fully packaged photonic wireless sub-THz receiver module.

articleTitle: An ultimate-high linear silicon modulator based on all-optical linearization method
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed an ultimate-high linear silicon-based modulator based on all-optical linearization method, which demonstrates an SFDR as high as 131/127 dB•Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6/7</sup> at 1/10 GHz.

articleTitle: Bend Insensitive Hollow Core DNANF with SMF-Matching Mode Field Diameter and 125μm Outer Diameter for Low Loss Direct Interconnection in Short Reach Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present the first 125μm outer diameter hollow-core fibre with a 10.6μm mode-field diameter allowing direct low-loss splicing to G652 SMF. We demonstrate O-to-C-band transmission and bend-insensitive single-mode operation, attractive for low-latency sub-1km communications.

articleTitle: Distributed Acoustic Sensing Over Passive Optical Networks Using Enhanced Scatter Fiber
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Simultaneous fiber-optic sensing and NG-PON data transmissions over a 1x16 splitter is demonstrated by enhanced scatter fiber. Acoustic signals from a single distribution fiber are identified. The crosstalk between sensing and data channels is studied.

articleTitle: Simultaneous IM/DD Data Transmission and High-Rate Secret Key Distribution over a Single C-band Channel
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate hierarchical multiscale PAM-4 transmission combining 500 Mbps data transfer with optical-layer cryptographic key distribution at rates 24.14 Mbps and 8.38 Mbps secure against passive eavesdropper advantage 0 dB and 6 dB respectively.

articleTitle: Beam-Steering Based on Dispersive Optical Phased Array for FMCW LiDAR Application
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate dispersive optical phased arrays based on the Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>-on-Si platform. Two-dimensional beam steering across a 45.6° × 10° FOV with a beam width of 1.45° × 0.032° is achieved by wavelength tuning alone. Besides, FMCW ranging operation at a target distance of 10 m are experimentally performed.

articleTitle: Double-decker CDC-ROADM node for multi-band network with wavelength band granularity
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose double-decker ROADM node by introducing a band cross-connect in addition to the conventional wavelength cross-connect, which is suitable for a multi-band network. This configuration provides improved transmission characteristics compared with a conventional CDC-ROADM.

articleTitle: SM-TCC-VCSEL-based 800 Gbps Linear Drive Pluggable Transceiver
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We developed the world's first SM-VCSEL based 800 Gbps LPO transceiver. By adopting 8ch-1060nm high-speed TCC-VCSEL array with superior linearity, the TECQ of 2.1dB and 2km SMF transmission with 5pJ/bit were successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Cryptographic Key Generation Using Conventional Single-Mode Fiber and an Optical Time Domain Reflectometer
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Generation of cryptographic key is demonstrated by conventional equipment for an optical network. Random bit sequences obtained from an optical time domain reflectometry of a single-mode fiber satisfies a quality of randomness as cryptographic keys.

articleTitle: Free Space Communication Enabled by Directly Modulated Quantum Cascade Laser
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We summarize our recent experimental studies of free-space communications enabled by directly modulated quantum cascade lasers at both MWIR and LWIR regions. Different detector types with different characteristics are compared.
