publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We monitor a 524-km live network link using an real-time FPGA-based sensing-capable transceiver prototype during a human-caused cable break. Polarization sensing data shows minute-level potential break warning precursors, offering outage mitigation prospects.

articleTitle: Photon-Counting Technologies for Efficient High-Capacity Space-to-Ground Laser Communications§
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Photon-counting optical receivers have the best sensitivity but are practically limited to relatively low data rates < ~1 Gbit/s. Here, we present technologies that can extend sensitive photoncounting-performance into the 100 Gbit/s regime and beyond.

articleTitle: First Demonstration of Net-1.6-Tbps 4λ-WDM in 150-GHz-Grid IM/DD Transmission with a Single DAC/channel and Advanced DSP for Intra-Datacenter-Interconnects
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: For the first time, we experimentally demonstrate net-400-Gb/s/lane 150-GHz-spaced 4λ-WDM transmission over 0.5-km SSMF in C-band for intra-datacenter-interconnects based on 128-GBaud probabilistically shaped PAM-20, using a single DAC per channel and driver-free, high-bandwidth TFLN modulators.

articleTitle: Towards Tbps Single-λ Interconnect by a Multimode Integrated Optical I/O on Silicon for Few-Mode Fibers
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A six-channel multimode integrated optical I/O supporting two orthogonal polarizations of LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</inf>, LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11a</inf>, and LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11b</inf> modes in a few-mode fiber was experimentally demonstrated, showing chip-to-fiber coupling efficiencies > −6.1dB for future Tbps-per-wavelength optical interconnects.

articleTitle: Quantum Networks: Exploring Scalability, Topology, and Error Correction
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce Quantum Tree Networks, a k-ary tree topology for scalable, error-corrected entanglement routing. Using sublinear qubit overhead and network-level simulations, we demonstrate efficient routing and congestion avoidance.

articleTitle: High-Speed Multilevel Coded Modulation and Soft Performance Monitoring in Optical Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We implemented and evaluated probabilistically-shaped multilevel coded modulation and soft-information based performance monitoring at throughputs from 200 Gb/s to 1.2 Tb/s for multi-haul fiber-optic communications. Error-free operations were observed in 5- to 128-ary modulation formats.

articleTitle: Frequency-Comb-Enabled Photonic RF Memory for Multi-False-Target Radar Compound Jamming
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the first all-optical multi-false-target radar jamming scheme using frequency-comb-enabled photonic RF memory. More than 10 false targets with range-velocity deception information are obtained, with storage time exceeding 840μs and signal frequency reaching 16GHz.

articleTitle: On the Impact of Spatial Mode Dispersion for Mode-dependent Loss Estimation and Mitigation in Coupled-core MCF Links
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Impact of SMD on MDL estimation and mitigation in CC-MCF links is theoretically investigated. SMD below 10 ps/km is mandatory to ensure the efficient MDL mitigation in 1000-km CC-MCF links.

articleTitle: 150.27-Tb/s Capacity over 150-km in S+C+L Band Using 156-Channel 115-GBaud Signals with Doped Fiber Amplification
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 150.27-Tb/s S-, C- and L-band optical signal over 150-km G.654.E transmission in a 19.5-THz bandwidth with only DFAs. The average per-wavelength capacity is over 960-Gbit/s after entropy optimization in each band.

articleTitle: A 100 W Output Power Coherent Transmission Link for Future High Data Rate Earth-to-Satellite Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An optical coherent transmission link with 100Watt output power is tested for satellite communications. Modulation formats are tested for transmission of the highest data-rates despite of nonlinear amplifier impairments across a linear, low-SNR free-space link.

articleTitle: Accurate SNR Estimation in C+L-band 10-THz Hybrid Raman-EDFA Amplified Transmission Using Two-Stage Power Profile Calculation Accounting for Pump Depletion
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an accurate power profile calculation method for GN-model-based SNR estimation and demonstrate an average SNR estimation error of 0.22 dB in C+L-band 101-ch WDM 96-Gbaud PCS-36QAM signal 1120-km hybrid Raman-EDFA amplified transmission.

articleTitle: 1.6 Tbps (224 Gbps/λ) Silicon Photonic Engine Fabricated with Advanced Electronic-Photonic FOWLP for Co-Packaged Optics and Linear Drive Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 1.6 Tbps (8-channel 224 Gbps/λ) Silicon Photonic Engine, fabricated using advanced electronic-photonic FOWLP, is successfully demonstrated for the first time, enabling low-cost, volume-manufacturable and highly scalable terabit photonic engines for CPO and LPO.

articleTitle: Broadband Transmission Opto-mechanical Switch Based on Cylindrical Ferrule Rotation Switching Using Fiber Bundle Inserted in Ferrule
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate an opto-mechanical switch based on rotation of a ferrule holding a fiber bundle. Excellent loss and reflection characteristics comparable with those of optical connectors are achieved in the telecommunication wavelength bands.

articleTitle: Scaling Optical Network Fault Management with Decentralized Graph Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a decentralized graph learning framework for scaling cognitive fault management in optical networks. Results show the proposed design achieves > 96% fault identification and localization accuracy.

articleTitle: Adaptive and DSP-Compatible Optical Multipath Interference Mitigation Scheme for 60Gbps PAM8-CRAN
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed an adaptive DSP-compatible time-varying multipath interference noise mitigation algorithm based on probability distribution over 15.5km SSMF at 56/60Gbps PAM4/8. The signal-to-interference ratio tolerance improvement of 3dB PAM8 shows its potentiality for high-order PAM.

articleTitle: 8λ×462Gb/s Transmission with Symmetric Carrier-Assisted Differential Detection Using Delay-Unknown Field Recovery
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We implement symmetric carrier-assisted differential detection receiver as an LO-free alternative to single-polarization coherent receiver. Using 2×1 MIMO equalizer-based optical field recovery and SSBI cancellation, 3.7Tb/s(=8λ×462Gb/s) PS-64-QAM signals are transmitted over 25-km SSMF for data-center-interconnects.

articleTitle: Tailoring Transceiver Designs for Subsea
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Unique challenges that subsea cables introduce which influence optical transceiver design are described. DSP algorithms that address these challenges are discussed and the use of subsea transceivers for seismic sensing is also introduced.

articleTitle: ASE Source enabled 2 Tb/s CPRI-Equivalent Rate 1024-QAM DA-RoF Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate unprecedented 2nm broadband ASE source-enabled digital-analog radio-over-fiber mobile fronthaul system with joint force of SOAs for intensity noise suppression and multicore fiber for self-homodyne detection. We achieve 35GHz(=7core×5GHz) aggregated bandwidth with 2Tb/s CPRI-equivalent data rate supporting 1024-QAM signal.

articleTitle: Novel In-Line Triage Methodology for High-Speed Optical Transceivers in Hyperscale Datacenters
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel in-line triage methodology has been developed by leveraging data collected from optical transceivers and network switches. A success rate of ~68% was achieved by correlating diagnosis from triage to failure analysis from vendors.

articleTitle: Optical Fiber Tags Based on Encoded FBG Array
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We proposed an optical fiber tag for identifying the massive passive optical networks, which were encoded by the FBG array with 7 wavelengths and 5 intensity grades, and achieved 5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> optical tag identification.

articleTitle: A Low Complexity Coherent 16×400 Gbit/s 4SC-16QAM DSCM system with Precise Transceiver IQ Skew Compensation and Simplified Equalization
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A low complexity coherent 16×400 Gbit/s datacenter interconnect with 50Gbaud 4SC-16QAM DSCM signal is experimentally demonstrated, enabled by a novel low complexity transceiver IQ skew estimation method and simplified equalizer embedded phase tracking.

articleTitle: 519.21Gbps Optical Interconnect Using 50-Channel Pre-equalized WDM Visible Light Laser Communication System
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a record-breaking 519.21Gbps transmission using an integrated WDM visible light laser communication system and hardware pre-equalization for the first time. It is a promising solution for next generation optical interconnects in data centers.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Auxiliary Management and Control Channel Transmission and Data-Channel Signal Compensation for Beyond 100G FDM Coherent PON
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate the transmission of AMCC and a novel signal-compensation method for data-channel in coherent FDM-PON. Sensitivity improvement of 6 dB is demonstrated with 150G capacity over 20-km fiber for FDM-PON with AMCC.

articleTitle: Advancements in Key Technological Building Blocks for Enabling MCF Implementation
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Multi-core fiber (MCF) technology has made significant progress since the capacity limitations of single-mode fiber had been posed. This presentation will review the advancements and readiness of MCF and its key components, showcasing the technical feasibility of MCF technology in real-world applications.

articleTitle: Experimental Disaggregation of Propagation Effects in Optical Links
publicationTitle: 2024 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We introduce a protocol to evaluate experimentally the fiber nonlinear coefficients for intra- and inter-channel effects. We characterized a three-span transmission using highly dispersed QPSK signals, observing good agreement with the eGN model.
